Had she remembered something from her previous life? Are you an evil villainess? Am I going to break you if I fool around too much? A me that's programmed to be like that, is so horrible. Isn't that right~ An "event" and those "program settings" have no connection to me though. Let's go back to my place and I'll slowly and sweetly make you fall desperately in love with me!

129006.description: High school student Kusakabe Makoto has to work all day to raise money for the treatment of his younger sister, who suffers from a serious illness. The father is unemployed, the mother ran away, leaving the children, bullying at work ... Despite all this, he does not lose hope and continues to live for her sister. But having learned that she did not have long, Makoto falls into despair. Fear of the unknown causes him to take a different look at the value of human life.

129009.description:
A sugary romcom with a happy ending – the author guarantees it! Koyuki Shirogane is feared throughout her school for her sharp tongue, so much so that she's become known as "The Queen of Thorns!" One day, Naoya Sasahara rescues her from a pushy classmate's advances. That's when he learns that she's nothing more than a normal girl who's adopted her harsh demeanor as a facade to protect herself. Koyuki ends up falling for the gallant Naoya, while he ends up smitten with her more vulnerable side. Are the two capable of being honest about their feelings? Find out as, little by little, their hearts begin to open up!

(Source: Tentai Books)

129014.description:
After a major screw-up at work, Hyunho is pretty much ready to give up on life. What he receives instead of punishment, however, is a delectable strawberry cream custard tart. Thinking it's his last meal alive, Hyunho gobbles it up, licking every last dollop of cream off of Seung-yun's fingers. This lights a certain spark within Seung-yun, which gets him thinking about all the other wild things he could make Hyunho do with his tongue...

(Source: Lezhin)

Chapter count includes Christmas Special

129015.description:
Meet Leo, a stray cat who accidentally picks up an abandoned dog, Milky.

To avoid a bad reputation from the other stray cats, Leo teaches Milky how to survive in the streets... But can he keep his cool through Milky's adorable demeanor?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

129018.description:
Muromiya is a short salaryman who gets teased a lot because of his height and gets assigned to train new employee Sera, who’s super tall. It’s pretty obvious that Sera thinks Muromiya is super cute, and one day after a drinking party they kiss...

Note: Contains the extra "Oogata Shinjin to Kyouikugakari" (大型新人と教育係).

129020.description:
First impressions are everything, right? But it doesn’t seem that way when Yi-Kyung comes across Joo-Bin. When they first meet, Joo-Bin is just a handsome stranger with an exciting air of mystery. Yi-Kyung itches to draw him, to sketch out his beauty on paper like the artist he is… But at their next encounter, Joo-Bin is a completely different person. Sensitive, outspoken, and passionate about his own work as a photographer, he proposes that Yi-Kyung become his model. And drawn to this other side of his, Yi-Kyung says yes. Between lens and paper, who’ll be the first to sketch out the other to perfection?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

129021.description:
A fateful encounter kicks off adventure for a cat reborn in a world with no cats! Tragedy strikes a kitty in our world, and she gets a second chance at life in a fantasy world. A hero, heading home after battling a demon king, crosses paths with a mysterious creature. What is this fluffy new friend, and should she pet the belly?

An array of fantasyland adventurers learn about snack time, toe beans, and that (eye)balls can be toys. When the knight captain's folded-eared cat meets the hero's cat, paw-to-paw combat breaks out between the fuzz balls! Then, the hero winds up working part-time at a cat café with...the demon king?! Cuddle up with a four-legged companion and enjoy this once-in-a-reincarnated-lifetime furry fantasy!

(Source: Square Enix)
synonyms: A Story about a Cat Reincarnated in a Different World Where There are no Cats.

129023.description:
Enter Hoshikawa Yuu, a boy cute enough that people mistake him for a girl, and Kohinata Akari, a classmate of his who recently moved her seat next to him.

This is a story about the two high school students sitting next to one another, and who each think that the other is the cutest one around.

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

Seol-Hee used to work with Jae-Wook at an amusement park before he got fired for beating up a pervert who harassed her. They meet again at night where she works a second job, as a karaoke hostess. Can she handle two jobs and a relationship?

(Source: TOPTOON+, edited)

129028.description:
Ichika Kinohara enters high school still pining for her childhood crush. She remembers that boy Yuito as a cute innocent kid. But when Ichika found out that Yuito has returned to attend the same high school, she discovered that he's become a super handsome young man!?

A sweet love story about girl meets boy, again.

129029.description: Before Narumi Taiga, Bitou Tatsuya, King Joe and Tsukimoto Mitsumasa, there was Terakado Butta. This is the story of how, under his leadership, Housen became the powerhouse that would become Suzuran High School's greatest opponent. Butta was there the year the school was founded, and without him, we would have never had the Housen Hitman we know and fear today.

title.romaji: Crows Gaiden Housenka: the beginning of HOUSEN

129030.description:
'I', along with that girl, 'me' and that girl's 'Mama'. An early afternoon in summer on a listless day, the relationship between 'I' and 'Mama' started with the scent of her breasts dewed with sweat. A passionate and erotic story by Tsuyatsuya about love triangle involving both mother and daughter!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

Min Yeon-U goes on a blind date after being in a one-sided love for ten years. But the blind date … is the person who gave him a plastic surgery consultation a few years ago?!?!?! Will he put an end to Yeon-U’s ten years of unrequited love?

“Doctor…! Can you operate on love too?!”

(Source: Bookcube, translated)

129033.description: Seo Geun-Woo is a perfect top star, he got it all, looks, posture, aura, eliteness, you name it… He is usually picky and hard to please, especially to any movie that he attends to. Until one day, a newcomer actress Min Seo-Yeon caught his eye, for some reason he can’t fathom what about with this girl that his usual compose self is faltering in the presence of this Lady, makes him uncomfortable but in a pleasant way… Is this what they call love? A Story with romance for all ages.
synonyms: My Heart Races Because of You

129034.description:
She was supposed to break the love flag, but… she ends up having feelings for him?! This is the start of an unexpected romantic comedy♪

Mariko Kanzaki, a single office lady around her thirties, apparently got reincarnated in the world of her favorite otome game as Cecilia, a villain (and a death-confirmed character)!! Only the death penalty awaits her at this rate…! In order to change her destiny, she planned to break off her engagement with Prince Kaiser (a scheming man) but, unexpectedly, she started liking him after he told her: “This is the first time I met someone like you.”
synonyms: I Won't Accept That I Am a Villainess in an Otome Game!!

129036.description:
Pei’s mother, a goddess of the royal empire, was sentenced to death by the King for the cause of natural disasters. While she survived, she felt the cold injustices of the King and was left to be exploited. Now she must find out the truth behind her mother’s unjust death in order to change the attitude of others.
While treated with indifference by the crown prince, Pei will work hard to reveal the empire’s secrets!
synonyms: The King Wants Me to Die

129038.description:
Shen Ying, a foodaholic girl with no sense of direction from the modern world, came to another world through time travel. She had no money and couldn't get out of the spirit world. Incredibly talented as a martial arts master but also easily neglected, Shen Ying is like a bug in a video game.
Shen Ying took Yi Qing, an upstanding swordsman, as her disciple although, at first, she only wanted him to cook for her.
Yi Qing, a man of integrity and conscience, was defeated in a fight with a demon and fell into the yard of Shen Ying who later became his master through serendipity.
However, Shen Ying and Yi Qing always talked past each other. Later they entered Xuantian Clan and with Shen Ying's simple explanations and his own imagination, Yi Qing gradually became an unbeatable swordsman in the world.
This is a funny story about cultivation featuring two characters with strikingly different dispositions: an upright, gentle disciple and a hilarious but powerful master.

(Source: Webnovel)

129039.description:
Yu-Bi leads the action-packed life of a legendary martial artist on the hunt for her father's killer. Shin-Woo is the aloof teen heartthrob with a heart of gold who's searching for his leading lady. As heroes of their own respective genres, their destinies are seemingly set in stone. But when their worlds collide in a miraculous twist of fate, the two team up to stray from the paths originally laid out for them. Now, they'll have to mix tropes of both the action and romance genres to battle assassins, terminal illnesses, and unnecessary love triangles. As they enter each other's worlds and come to understand the struggles of one another, will these lost protagonists be able to overcome the odds and make it to their happily ever after?

(Source: Tappytoon)

129044.description:
Touki Futahara is the younger sister of Iori Fuyutsuki's childhood friend and an incoming student at their high school. She's a self-proclaimed little devil and "the girl most envied by seniors." Now she's waiting at Touki's door every morning.

"Senpai! Give me your hand! Let's hold hands to stay warm!"

But Iori knows that Touki's actually more like a shy puppy who blushes at the slightest touch. All the bold teasing is just an act, and she's feeling nervous inside.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 今はまだ「幼馴染の妹」ですけど。
title.romaji: Ima wa Mada "Osananajimi no Imouto" desu kedo.

129049.description:
In his third year of playing pro, the 20-year-old goalkeeper, Ao Kamiya, was selected for the Japan national team for the first time since he carried his club from the lower ranks to the third place. On the day of the match, Kamiya, who started in the latter half of the game, defended the goal from the national team, despite the heavy pressure. Meanwhile, Kamiya's "one-play" became a mess throughout the venue.

This is another soccer drama presented by Takatoshi Nakamura, the author who wrote the award-winning 1/11.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Included one-shot:
Volume 1: Hiraku

129052.description:
Nagisa, a talented saleswoman, is brought to a store to entertain a client. This store, called “Oppabu”, is a place where handsome men serve customers with their beautiful bodies! Nagisa is confused, but Fuka, the cast member, is very gentle and sexy. Her hands can’t seem to stop and Nagisa can’t help but to caress him more as he reacts sexually. Turned on with her cuteness, and he becomes more and more aggressive… But while it seems like it’s just a fleeting romance between a cast member and a customer, it turns out that Fuka-san (Kazehana Zen) has a big, big secret!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 雄っぱぶ…って何ですか! ～吸って吸われて始まる恋の話～
title.romaji: Oppabu... tte Nandesu ka! Sutte Suwarete Hajimaru Koi no Hanashi

129053.description:
The story centers on a housewife who has a husband who is prone to cheating on her, but one day she meets a man through social media.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: 恋愛無罪-愛を誓ったはずだよね？
title.romaji: Renai Muzai: Ai wo Chikatta Hazu da yo ne?

title.native: デリ恋 ～好きになったのはイケメンドライバーでした～
title.romaji: Deli Koi: Suki ni Natta no wa Ikemen Driver Deshita

129056.description:
The "saintly gentleman" Mr. Ujihara and the "pure and innocent" Ms. Fuyutsuki are boss and subordinate at work. Others tease them for their lack of romantic interests and their innocent appearance, but with the strong encouragement of their co-workers, they became an official couple supported by everyone in the company. Then came the their first night together. They got into bed and tried to throw off their masks of "gentleman" and "innocence" that they had been hiding behind until then.......?
But because of "certain circumstances," even thought they really wanted to say "I want to have sex with you," they just couldn't let it out. Instead, they have to settle for intense, explosive sexual fantasies. Will the day ever come when they can tell each other how they really feel and make their desires come true...?

(Source: Melt Comics, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes one extra from the volume releae.

title.native: 「エッチしたい」と言ってくれ ―聖人（？）部長と純真（？）OL―

129057.description:
"Let's be friends with benefits."

Misano has lived her life responsibly, but she's finally had enough. Determined to be a free-loving woman, she decides to try a one-night stand. One thing leads to another, and now they're friends with benefits. Things couldn't get any more out of hand until he transfers to her company?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.native: 清く正しくいやらしく

129058.description:
Kamisama and Futari Kiri is a master-servant romance between Mia, a servant, and her master, Joshua. Mia, an orphan, is fascinated with Joshua, who saved her from being falsely accused of theft when she was a child, as he is "like a god." However, being the son of an oppressive former lord, Joshua's reputation is not good, and Mia is bitterly disappointed when she goes to work for him. All Mia can think about is making the people of the city understand how charming Joshua is, but Joshua sweetly whispers to her, "I desire Mia's love..."

(Source: Comic Natalie, translated)

Notes:
- Began as a one-shot in The Hana to Yume White Love 3/1 issue on January 27, 2021. Serialization began in Hana to Yume #15 with a revised version of the one-shot, now named "chapter 1," on July 5, 2021.
- Includes a side story, an omake chapter, and the one-shot "Koi wo Yoru" (恋をよる).

title.native: かみさまとふたリきリ

129060.description: Ten years as a manager. My level is chief, but suddenly, I was picked up by Korea’s top star Kim Dan and work like a new recruit?! The man famous for his bad personality, and now he is trying to tame me? You’re just making me do a lot of weird jobs that even doesn’t make sense! Why don’t you just wait and see? I’m not that easy! A contractual relationship between a top star and a manager, it’s starting now!
synonyms: スターの彼女になってしまいました

Maria is overwhelmed by terrible feelings of shame every time just before sex with her boyfriend, which leads him to dump her. When she reveals her problems to the monk Kuon, he offers his help. 129065.description:
Hotaru Morino is a second year high school student who has had an unrequited crush on Ren Otaka since junior high school. One day, while on a school trip with Ren and her good friend Shiori Yamamoto, their bus gets into an accident. When Hotaru wakes up, a young man who is dressed fully in black appears in front of her. He is Kuro, a grim reaper. A shocked Hotaru shoves him away but he has shocking words for her: "I'm your guide. Hotaru Morino, listen carefully. You're dead."

Hotaru learns that if she does not get over her attachment to three things within 49 days, she will end up becoming a ghost bound to a specific physical location and wouldn't be able to rest in peace. She had slept for one month after the accident and has only 19 days left. And so, Hotaru sets out to settle the three lingering regrets with the limited time she has, in the company of Kuro.

One of them is to confess her feelings to Ren, her crush of five years. However, when he is in front of her, she finds it impossible to tell him how she feels. As Hotaru settles her first lingering regret, dark clouds begin to gather over her and Kuro...

Today, another fierce "family quarrel" over an inheritance began at the funeral of a well-known author. One man, Nanao Haie, arrived at the funeral, attracted by the smell of such a "family quarrel." Haie, who claimed to be a detective specializing in inheritance disputes, uses his hyena-like senses to sniff out the truth behind a "video will" left by the deceased writer...! This is an ambitious work that weaves various types of inheritance battles into an exquisite mystery!

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

Scarlett, who has lost her lover six times to her friend, had always believed and forgiven her friend's words that are pitiful yet beautiful. "It was for you, Scarlett. Haven't you always said that any man who can get taken away easily isn't yours?"

But as soon as the veil falls off, Scarlett finally decides to take revenge on her friend. And soon, in front of her friend, she kisses her friend's fiancé deeply. "I'm the one who is sorry for not seeing your evil intentions, but you shouldn't have thought that I'd stay an idiot forever."

All of these are revenge for me. Quiet and promiscuous.

129099.description: Sera was born to an English mother and strict Greek father and raised following Greek customs. On the day she turned 18, she ran away from home, disappointed by her father's distance and uncaring nature. Meanwhile, the playboy Dark, an aristocrat from England, was told he would not get his inheritance unless he married within six months. The two meet in Acropolis, Greece, and Sera and Dark decide to marry on the condition that they both get to live freely. However, Sera's clarity and vibrant nature begin to attract Dark more and more...

129100.description:
Marie has spent her life living under her sister’s shadow as the two grew up in an impoverished baron’s home. Every nice thing went to Marie’s sister, leaving her without even a proper dress! And right when her sister was being married off to a wealthy Earl–tragedy strikes and Marie’s sister is killed en route. With the dowry already spent, it’s decided that Marie will take her sister’s place and become the Earl’s betrothed. But, when she gets there, she finds there’s been a serious mix-up—the proposal was a total misunderstanding! Can Marie win the heart of the handsome Earl, or is she destined to live a life without a single nice thing?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

129101.description:
“You are not the real saint, you’re nothing but a fake—!!!”

I, Eliane, am suddenly exiled. Not only that, my engagement was also annulled by Claude, who was both my fiancé and the first prince of my country.

Claude claims that Leticia is the ‘real saint’, but I know from the beginning, she is the woman he has been cheating on me with. So here I am, sharing his wish to cancel our engagement.

But, is exiling me truly a wise decision, I wonder? Exiling this me, the actual ‘real saint’ who has been setting up barriers and supporting this kingdom from shadows?

Maybe, just maybe, dragons and archdemons will invade my kingdom starting from tomorrow. Who knows—

—not like it’s any of my business anymore.

I have abandoned my own country and have thus decided to have a peaceful life.

Meanwhile, the kingdom, which has lost its true saint, is on the path to ruin.

Whenever there was a danger, he would always help her like a real god fallen from the heaven, mocking her at the same time. With the lapse of time, her feelings for him was more than just dependence. She thought she was going to work independently, but to her surprise, Daniel wants her to be his personal assistant! Charlotte feels like he doesn’t trust her abilities as a lawyer and wants to keep an eye on her. Loved by everyone and an accomplished lawyer, Daniel seems like he has the perfect life. However, Charlotte learns that he inherited his grandmother’s successful business and it makes her resent him even more. Clearly Mr. Perfect had everything handed to him on a plate, unlike her! The prophet says that the next king will be "a woman named Essirjar, born with a red rose tattoo on her chest". The princes immediately depart in search of women with red roses on their chests. Amuzad, the second prince and most ambitious, sends his sister to help search for Essirjar.

129126.description: Is this fate? Chess, a close friend of Benjamin, appears before him looking for a roommate. Will this meeting rekindle the friendship they once had? Or will this turn out into something better? Watch out as their story unfolds...

Now six months into their relationship, the two have graduated from dates at a pancake shop to spending their nights together, but when a coworker spots Togawa wearing one of Nozue’s ties to work, it sends Nozue spiraling into doubt about the feasibility of their relationship.

Nako's been summoned as a sacred figure, but she doesn't have the special powers her summoners expected to make this "other world" a better place. She's sent away to live in a detached palace with Lynn, her lady-in-waiting, until one day, she's ordered to marry an earl who's said to be the country's hero. The thing is, he's over the age of 60. However, Nako takes one look at him and instantly falls in love with his gentle, reserved nature. Although this hero is aware that he's old and doesn't have much of a future ahead, he can't stop being attracted to the bright, cheerful girl. Little does he know that he will soon wake up and find that he is back in his twenties! This is a much-awaited romantic comedy between different worlds that will make you laugh, cry, and giggle right alongside the lovey-dovey couple!!

The sick and weak Crown Prince of Daqi, Feng Jin Yan has only one last breath left so the emperor ordered the chaplain, Wu Nian to perform the opening altar practice and use the method of invoking the soul to snatch back his beloved son from the Halls of Hell. However, he did not know that after the practice, Wu Nian brought back the most tyrannical prince in history, Feng Wu Yu, who was from 900 years ago instead. The emperor cried at the feet of the chaplain "return my cute and soft prince to me!" Wu Nian replied with a serious fudge "the crown prince is not hurt, he just lost his mind, he will be cured after being treated by me". Instead of really curing the prince, in her thoughts, she was thinking "thousand years old soul, that will be a great tonic ah! Hehehe~".

Yu Mashiro, a former delinquent who was feared as the "White Tiger of the West," pursued her dream of working in print design, and landed a respectable job at a small printing company in the suburbs of Tokyo. Of course, she tries to hide her notorious past... She is thrilled to have a job that allows her to work on the manga she loves, but she is also subjected to the usual hassles of life at a printing company and teasing from her seniors, who have their own quirks, which is making her delinquent temperament on the verge of exploding in full force. This is the start of a work comedy in which Mashiro, who is single-minded in everything she does, struggles through the rough and tumble life of a printing company!

title.native: 乙女ゲームで死にたくないんです

129151.description: At a glance, Chizuru Ayase looks like your average fresh-faced employee. However, she held a secret that she couldn’t tell anyone… During her last summer vacation in high school, she had been summoned to another world and became its savior. And in this past, she had fallen in love with its Hero, ‘The Knight of Blaze.’ This is a fantasy romance about unrequited love in a medieval setting.

title.native: Only with Your Heart～烈炎の騎士と最果ての恋人～
title.romaji: Only with Your Heart: Retsuen no Kishi to Saihate no Koibito

129152.description:
If you think being reincarnated once is a big deal, try seven times. From lowly pharmacist to embattled knight, Rishe has lived many lives. This time around, she’s determined to live in the lap of luxury–but there’s just one catch. To make her extravagant dreams come true, she has to marry the prince who killed her in one of her previous lives! It’s going to take every one of the skills she’s honed over multiple lifetimes to accomplish this goal!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: The Villain Daughter Enjoys Her Seventh Life as a Free-Spirited Bride (Hostage) in a Former Enemy Country
ชีวิตลูปที่ 7 ของนางร้าย ขอเป็นเจ้าสาวนอนกลิ้งสบายในแดนอดีตศัตรู

title.english: 7th Time Loop: The Villainess Enjoys a Carefree Life Married to Her Worst Enemy!
title.native: ループ7回目の悪役令嬢は、元敵国で自由気ままな花嫁生活を満喫する
title.romaji: Loop 7-kaime no Akuyaku Reijou wa, Moto Tekikoku de Jiyuu Kimama na Hanayome Seikatsu wo Mankitsu Suru

129153.description:
Prince Reidrick was similar to the legendary Golden Wolf Emperor; a man who could completely change into a wolf. Sara Grisosta is a daughter of an Earl living at the borders. Because she does not show any smiles to men, she was called as the Ice princess, and was the first prince Shuudel’s bride candidate.

In the courtyard of the royal palace, Sara meets Reidrick who turned into a golden wolf and his human self, believing that the former to be a royal breed of dog.

Sara’s heart was captured by the Golden Doggy-chan; Reidrick is unable to tell her the truth that he’s actually a human who could turn into a wolf.

It is an ero ero love story which starts off from stroking fluffy fur~
synonyms: The Wolf Prince and the Ice Princess

title.native: オオカミ殿下と氷の姫君
title.romaji: Ookami Denka to Koori no Himegimi

129154.description:
Chiharu and Maki have worked at the same company together for three years. They were both unceremoniously dumped this spring. As they were drowning their sorrows with sake, they were both summoned to another world. They were given the very simple job of cleansing miasma.

Well, there's no way around it. Thus they begin their quest for alcohol, delicious food, and if possible, a faithful boyfriend.
129154.hashtag: #聖女二人の異世界ぶらり旅

title.native: 聖女二人の異世界ぶらり旅
title.romaji: Seijo Futari no Isekai Burari Tabi

129155.description:
I finally confessed to a stud and was about to usher in some sweet love in my life, but I got electrocuted and teleported into a world of immortal cultivation?! But thanks to my hacks, I've turned from zero to hero. Not only do I have to bring my senior brothers to fight monsters and level up, I have to deal with all these distractions all day too. It's not easy being a pretty lady! So, which senior should I pick for tonight? I gotta think about it...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)
synonyms: Bitch, I'm a Young Lady with Hax
The Tyrannical Lady Has a Cheat!

title.english: I’m the Girl With the Hacks!

129156.description:
Oh Jin-Sim was a star actress until a scandal left her career in tatters. But when a renowned screenwriter offers her the lead in their next legal drama, she knows it could be her comeback. The problem is, Jin-Sim is more famous for her looks than her acting. To prove she can take on the role, she starts working as a real-life legal secretary. Too bad her boss, cold-hearted Gwon Jeong-Rok, is a complete jerk! So why is Jin-Sim catching feelings for him? When it comes to love, there are no laws!

(Source: Tapas, edited)
synonyms: 真心が届く～スターと堅物弁護士の恋!?～
รักโดนใจยัยซุปตาร์

title.romaji: Kaichou no Oose no Mama ni!

129163.description: Catriona Julie Grande, the daughter of a marquis, was the Crown Prince’s fiancee. She was executed under false charges but went back in time. All she wanted was to live her life peacefully and prevent the same tragic fate from occurring again. But one day, the Prince appears in her life again and everything begins to fall apart. She has no idea what to do!
synonyms: The Daughter of the Marquis, Who Was Executed Under False Accusation, Wants to Spend a Peaceful Life in the Land Protected by God

title.native: 冤罪で処刑された侯爵令嬢は今世ではもふ神様と穏やかに過ごしたい
title.romaji: Enzai de Shokei Sareta Koushaku Reijou wa Konse de wa Mofu Kami-sama to Odayaka ni Sugoshitai

title.native: みずまほ ～水着になったら魔法を出せた！～
title.romaji: Mizumaho: Mizugi ni Nattara Mahou wo Daseta!

129170.description:
When trying to solve tough missing-person cases, investigators ask for advice from Shirou Tomura, a specialist on the history of games.
His creative and accurate deductions have helped him to get to the bottom of the matter.
Busy with research and lectures, he receives many requests for cooperation from detectives.......
Intellectual curiosity is the driving force!
Watch out for the dangerous fieldwork of this eccentric gentleman!!

(Source: Nihonbungeisha, translated)
synonyms: Play of Associate Professor Mr. Tomura

129171.description:
Issac, who has memories of his previous life in Japan, is an apprentice gardener of a duke’s family. The duke’s house was the house of a rival daughter of an otome game played by his younger sister! But I realized that I’m not a mob in the game. There is no possibility of being caught up with the rival and facing ruin.

Does it make sense for me to have memories of my previous life?

That’s why I aimed to become a gardener without worrying about being in the world of an otome game.
129171.hashtag: #乙女ゲーのモブですらないんだが
synonyms: I’m Not Even an Otome Game Mob Character
Otome Game no Mob desura naindaga

title.native: 乙女ゲーのモブですらないんだが

129172.description: The manga centers on three friends who meet up at morning to get to the bottom of their town's "seven mysteries."

title.native: かわうその自転車屋さん

129174.description:
Pour Lui, the popular idol who rose to fame with BiS and now leads PIGGS as its CEO, producer, and performer, is a huge fan! May Satsuki, A.K.A May Igarashi, was a popular idol who took the center position of the popular idol group. At the height of her popularity, she announced her sudden departure from the group...and shockingly retired from the entertainment industry. As May lives her life as a member of the public, a fateful encounter awaits her...From Hiro Shibara, the creator of Online Sheep and Contract of the Ghost Marriage, comes a new neo-idol coming-of-age story, now begins!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

129176.description:
A lonely old painter and a girl with no friends. This is a story about two people who don't fit in, and how they learn how to love the world as it is.

(Source: Comic Action, translated)

Note: Includes a bonus chapter.

129179.description: There were rumours going around about the mysterious encounters of two men.

129180.description: Chu You has always been responsible and hard-working in order to fulfill her goal of becoming a famous movie director, but unexpectedly, she was betrayed by a scum man and woman! Not only was she falsely accused, she was also robbed of her hard-earned savings! In despair, she committed suicide with hatred, but after her rebirth, she's contracted with the Diva system?! Once a scumbag, always a scumbag! Now, what you made me experience before, I'll give it back to you in double!

129181.description:
She was the successor to a great healer, yet her reincarnation is a meek shadow of a girl. Call her stupid? Her alchemy and medical skills will stun skeptics! Laugh at her misfortune? She'll deal with her vicious stepmother and sister with a wave of her hand! All she wants after her reincarnation is vengeance and to live her life, but little does she know that she has caught the attention of the most noble man in the country. Her kiss-and-run scheme is thwarted because she's been captured against her will. "All actions have consequences, girl. Did no one teach you that?"

(Source: Bilibili Comics)
synonyms: Le Monde Renaissant de la Femme Épicée
No Molestes A La Mujer Caliente
Không Gian Trùng Sinh: Phu Nhân Hào Môn Không Dễ Đụng
Sugar and Spice from the Reborn Wife
The Fiesty Wife Is Not to Be Messed With

title.native: 重生空间：豪门辣妻不好惹
title.romaji: Chongsheng Kongjian: Haomen La Qi Buhaore

129182.description:
Cinderella takes the chance to get a new life. She gains a variety of opportunities to strike back at her enemy. Suspenseful elements are added into her life while she is pampered with the arrogant boss's love. The main character is unlike any other main characters in other stories. She is not pretty and sweet, she does not act tough but she is independent.

(Source: WeComics)

title.english: Hello Sweetie: Mr. Xu's Little Hottie
title.romaji: Hello Tianxin: Xu Shao de Xiao Lamei

129183.description:
The power harassment from Alfine ー his girlfriend and childhood friend ー who is the same age, grew up with him, and became adventurers together, is painful. She is a peerless beauty, a person with the title "Sword Master" and called the "Flawless Sword Goddess," a capable woman with achievements recognized by the kingdom and rewarded with appointment as a knight and became a noble. On the other hand, he is treated as that capable woman, Alfine’s accessory, gets abusive language hurled at him by her, and suffers from her harsh power harassment and insults to him as an adventurer, resulting in him losing his dignity as a man and as a person He has resigned himself to spending his daily life in the position of a lover-caretaker.

However, changes came to that daily life. Alfine, who becomes busy as the kingdom's knight, often is unable to take part in adventures. As a result, the times he takes requests alone increases, and he is able to regain his lost dignity. Then he becomes aware of the abnormality of his circumstances. So, to regain himself, he chooses to leave her and her repeated power harassment behind. In addition to all of the equipment he has received until then, he returns his sword, one of a pair they had exchanged when they became adventurers. Declaring that they are over, he leaves the place quickly.

"From now on, I will change my name and appearance and live freely."

As soon as he decides that, everything goes well. When he realizes, he is praised by the people around him and is the greatest adventurer on the frontier. What's more, he got a proposal to marry the frontier lord’s daughter from a female adventurer.
synonyms: A Sword Master Childhood Friend Power Harassed Me Harshly, So I Broke off Our Relationship and Make a Fresh Start at the Frontier as a Magic Swordsman
Kensei no Osananajimi ga Power Harass de Ore ni Tsuraku Atarunode, Zetsuen Shite Henkyou de ma Kenshi to Shite Denaosu Koto ni Shita
His Swordmaster Childhood Friend Hit Him Hard With Power Harassment, so He Cut Their Ties and Made a Fresh Start in the Frontier as a Magical Swordsman

title.native: 剣聖の幼馴染がパワハラで俺につらく当たるので、絶縁して辺境で魔剣士として出直すことにした。
title.romaji: Kensei no Osananajimi ga Pawahara de Ore ni Tsuraku Ataru node, Zetsuen shite Henkyou de Makenshi toshite Denaosu Koto ni Shita.

129184.description:
My father just remarried, and I now have a stepsister around the same age as me. What's more, is that I'm using her as my own personal fap-pet! She's the shortest at school. She's also got the biggest bust! For some reason, she's under the impression that it's her job to care for my sexual needs, and I'm not about to correct her any time soon~!

(Source: DLsite)

Note: A live-action AV adaptation (MIMK-113) was released on March 17th, 2023.
synonyms: My Big Step-Sister Thinks That Big Sisters Should Take Care Of Their Little Brother's Sexual Urges
My Big Stepsister Thinks It's Her Job to Care For My Sexual Needs

title.native: 弟の性欲処理は、姉がするものだと お義姉ちゃんは思っている。
title.romaji: Otouto no Seiyoku Shori wa, Ane ga Suru Mono da to Onee-chan wa Omotte iru.

129185.description:
Game rookie, Mo Xiaoxi, inexplicable time-traveled into a game which she always plays.
Moreover, she is forced by the system to become the empress...

(Source: WebComics)

129186.description: For the last 400 years, an island has been completely surrounded by walls, isolated from the rest of the world. Aira and Marue have always dreamed of voyaging outside the walls, where lies a devastating truth unbeknownst to them.

129187.description: High school student Sachiko is bullied daily and is the recipient of constant unpleasant pranks in class. The culprit is unknown, however, in truth, to Sachiko those days were not particularly painful. That is because her beloved Aida-sensei is there to save her. Bright, handsome, and with a strong sense of justice, he is popular with everyone. Of course to Sachiko he is her special hero. However, Aida-sensei has a secret...

129189.description:
It will be the first year of high school for Tooru and as such, she decided to go live with her grandpa to be close to school. But it turns out that the old man is a robot engineer with a peculiar dream... for which he created the robot assistant Spin! What will happen to Tooru from now on!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: 無敵鉄姫スピンちゃん

129194.description:
Machimiya and Nanao are in love with each other. Even though their love is mutual, their ages are nine years apart, and they have to do their best to keep this so-called inappropriate relationship a secret...

Note: Originally released at Comitia 113 and later published in Manga Life Storia for 2 chapters.

title.native: わたしたちの不適切な関係

129197.description:
I've time-traveled to be the most vicious empress in the world? Author, this character setting isn't right! Since I've been forced to accept the label being the No. 1 vicious empress, look what you made me do!

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: Make Way for Your Vicious Queen!

129198.description:
They say, "To be a scholar is to be at the top of society," and so during the Dafeng Dynasty, society has rejected martial arts to focus on education, and they even opened the imperial exams to women! As an illiterate daughter of a martial arts dojo, Cheng Manyi was forced by her father to pretend to be an educated lady. However, she found herself in trouble when the heir of a prominent family came to offer marriage. On their wedding night, her handsome new husband told her, "When madam takes top place on the imperial exams, please don't abandon your husband!"

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Note: Chapter counts includes a prologue and two extras.
synonyms: The Most Talented Woman in the World

129200.description:
Drowning in debt and looking for a way to survive, Taegyu is given the option to sell his wife, for a month. What will happen to them?

(Source: Toomics)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue

129204.description:
During his high school days Sung-Hyun was confirmed as an Omega, and his relationship with four alphas who were his friends was cut off. He thought that they would never meet each other again, but he found himself reunited with them again one day.

That fateful day, Sung-Hyun was surrounded by the four Alpha's and no matter how many inhibitors he took, he went into heat...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes two extras.

129205.description: A heart-warming cat life story about Sae, a typical office lady, and Nora, a cat that has the appearance of a human

title.native: ツンギレ猫のノラさん

129206.description: It was the season when the cicadas crowed. Seven men and women gather in a certain building. The seven were strangers and visited this building with their weaknesses seized by a mysterious person named Dante. An eerie mask on the wall begins to speak, "You will kidnap a certain person from now on."

129207.description: We are a cute fat meow and paper rabbit that likes eating, sleeping, more eating and more sleeping!

129209.description:
The state of Joseon is defeated by the invaders of the royal family.

Two girls are born with a power that both the emperor and his traitors can use. Will this light illuminate the chaos of the times that have come? Or will it be the reason an entire country burns out?

… A new story begins!

129210.description:
Kidnapping, murder, and risqué relationships! Within the scandalous pages of The Abysmal Flower, the downfall of Roxana Agrece's criminal family is already foretold. So when Cassis Pedelian, the heroine's older brother, is kidnapped by Roxana's father, she can either wait for the heroine's revenge... or take matters into her own hands, since Cassis is the key to her survival. But with deceitful characters on all sides, can Roxana and Cassis trust each other enough to bring down the brutal Agreces?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: How to Protect the Heroine’s Older Brother
The Way to Protect the Female Lead's Older Brother
Как защитить старшего брата главной героини
保护女主角哥哥的方法
ロクサナ〜悪女がヒロインの兄を守る方法〜
ฉันขอปกป้องพี่ชายนางเอก

129218.description:
Cordelia Grey, an editor at a publishing company, is given a manuscript of the sequel to The Princess and the Knight along with a vintage chest. But when she wakes up the next morning, the manuscript she placed in the chest is gone -- a letter is in its place. It’s from none other than Prince Archie Albert, the handsome playboy and protagonist from the novel. What begins as curiosity morphs into a deep friendship, but can they stop themselves from developing feelings for one another, and will they ever get to meet in person?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

129224.description:
A secret I can’t tell anyone! I have "erotic dreams".

Because her standards are too high, Saito Chihiro, 27 has no boyfriend. This is the story of how she escapes reality in erotic dreams. In reality, she’s hopeless with men but in her dreams, she can act freely. She’s been enjoying her dreams like usual when a new employee, Sakuma Remu, shows up. And for some reason, he knows about her erotic dreams! Suddenly Remu sprouts horns and a tail.

“Sign a contract with me in exchange for your erotic dreams,” he says. Is it ok to accept the lure of an Incubus and sign a contract?

Thus starts the love of an Incubus x Office Lady that began with a contractual relationship.

(Source: Eiwa Shuppansha, translated)

title.native: 妄想OLはインキュバスと×××したい
title.romaji: Mousou OL wa Incubus to XXX Shitai

129225.description: Akito Shirasawa, a high school boy whose father is a film director, sees something in the library preparation room. It was the "masturbation scene" of his classmate, Kaho Honjou. Akito is puzzled, but ends up filming it with his smartphone. Kaho notices Akito, and in the men's restroom, makes a "proposal" to Akito! Exposed high school girl and movie boy. The "exposed love" of twisted adolescence, begins!
synonyms: I Want To See You Embarassed
เทคนี้ที่ผมถ่ายเป็นเรื่องน่าอายที่เธอไม่คัท

title.native: 恥じらう君が見たいんだ

129226.description:
When even the gods abandoned her, a very different people will reach out and save her. A warm Japanese-style fantasy love story!

Tsukino and the rabbit tribe have always been loyal servants of the gods. But despite her best efforts, Tsukino failed at all her tasks. She ran away in shame and became lost in the forest, when she was saved by Kaoru, the chief of the barbaric wolf tribe. Now what does Kaoru really mean when he says he wants to marry her???
synonyms: 狼族長與笨手笨腳的兔妻子

title.native: 狼は落ちこぼれ兎を妻にする
title.romaji: Okami wa Ochikobore Usagi wo Tsuma ni Suru

129231.description:
Akari’s grandmother told her to move out of their house and live at a new place.

Turns out the place his moving in is a share house with 4 hot guys living in it. In exchange for free rent, Akari’s grandmother wants these four to make her into a better woman. Will they be able to transform Akari into one?

title.native: 今日から、君をシェアします。
title.romaji: Kyou kara, Kimi wo Share Shimasu.

129232.description: My body melts under his burning kisses and gentle caresses… I had no idea my foreign boss was this good!!

title.english: Don't Say No...: My Foreign Boss Is Not a Gentleman
title.native: 今夜、NOとは言わせない…外国人上司のケモノな本性
title.romaji: Konya, NO to wa Iwasenai...: Gaikokujin Joushi no Kemono na Honshou

129233.description:
Jin-U is a weak coward left in a world full of zombies, ruled by survival of the fittest. Then, there are those other survivors who would use him, or perhaps even protect him. In the midst of survivors fighting for the sake of survival, fun, and desire, what will Jin-U's fate be?

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes 2 prologue chapters and 2 extras.

129240.description:
A struggling cupid candidate Tae-Hwa goes through series of tests to finally become a cupid but his troubling past is holding him back. His test partner Dan-Baek, an elite student, dismisses Tae-Hwa for being a bad student but finds out the true story of Tae-Hwa and how he became a cupid candidate...

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and an extra.

129241.description:
Yoon Baek is a typical young man who works part-time jobs to make a living. One day, he comes across a stray cat that leads him to a veterinarian named Jay Blythe. After realizing that he met him before in his dreams, he comes to learn that he's been selected by Jay to be his next prey. Yoon later finds out that his older brother who went missing a few months back was also eaten by Jay, the tiger, before he lead him to Yoon for the tiger's next meal. In order to escape the curse of the tiger, he must find another sacrifice. But the blurred lines in their relationship makes their fate growingly uncertain.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Chapter count includes a prologue.

129242.description:
“I need your help, assistant manager. By that… I mean sexually.”

A sad office worker by day, reigning dom by night! Yang-Hwa, who lives a risqué double life, has another secret. Her gender changes whenever she has an orgasm, and the only way to change back is to have another orgasm… But why… did I have to have an orgasm with my irritating boss, assistant manager Kang, of all people…?!

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

129247.description:
Jeong Taeui has always lived in the shadow of his genius twin brother, but he’s never been unhappy with his ordinary life. When his uncle shows up at his doorstep with a dangerous job offer disguised as a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, Taeui is skeptical, but he reluctantly agrees to work as an agent for half a year. Despite his initial qualms, he quickly adjusts to his new environment using his outgoing, positive personality. But from the moment Taeui meets Ilay Riegrow, an agent from another branch, his peaceful life slowly starts to change. Everyone says Ilay is a sadistic psychopath who should be avoided at all costs, but Taeui knows there’s more to him than meets the eye. But getting to know Ilay is like playing with fire, and Taeui isn’t sure if he’s ready to get burned.

(Source: Tappytoon)

129248.description:
Jeong Ja-Su, a popular boy at school with a mysterious atmosphere, visits Ma Eun-Ha and asks him to fix his huge problem.

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

Note: Includes 12 extra chapters.
synonyms: Hello! My Sweet Red Bean Cream

129249.description:
An unknown virus broke out worldwide, degenerating humanity. Andy Biya had unfortunately died from the sudden disaster, but he unexpectedly awakened the power of reincarnation and even met Eno Edison, a proud and aloof person who exuded a dangerous aura. Following the fateful experience of birth and death with Eno, the both of them gradually learn the secrets of each other and the world.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and 7 extras.

129252.description:
1-2. Shuffle! (シャッフル! )
3. Kurara Sensei Boxing Kyoushitsu (クララ先生のボクシング教室)
4. Night Hawk no Onna (Night Hawkの女)
5. Midara BOOKS 4: Nisatsume no Shashinshuu (ミダラBOOKS 4 ～二冊目の写真集～)
6. Washu Shirayuki no Xmas (鷲羽白雪のXmas)
7. Seitokaichou no Kanshishitsu (生徒会長の姦視室)
8. Gakeppuchi Onsen Hanjouki (崖っぷち温泉 繁盛記)
9. Torokeru Kunoichi Adauchi-hen (とろけるくのいち 仇討変)

title.native: そんな理由で犯られちゃう?

129254.description:
1. Ian Ryokou no Yoru, Kaya-nee wa ( 慰安旅行の夜、カヤ姉は)
2. Kaya-nee, Tsuisou Suru (カヤ姉、追想する)
3. Kaya-nee, Shasou demo... (カヤ姉、車窓でも…)
4-5. AV Jou Kayano Nee-ko (AV嬢 カヤ野ねえ子)
6-9. Aisai Senshi Mighty Wife ( 愛妻戦士マイティ・ワイフ)
10. Yuusha Sanbiki: Bouken no Hajimari (勇者三匹の冒険 冒険の始まり)
11. BUST SHOT HONEY Third Shot (BUST SHOT HONEY サードショット)

title.native: スキを魅せたらハメられて

129256.description:
On the outside, Jeong Jaehan has it all. He’s a third-generation chaebol in charge of an incredibly successful film production company. Despite all the power and money, he’s been secretly suffering from a torturous ailment. After years of drugs and alcohol abuse, he’s lost the ability to orgasm- or so he thought. When someone from his past unexpectedly shows up, Jaehan experiences pleasure that he thought he’d lost forever...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 29 extra chapters.
synonyms: 片思い〜報われない恋をした〜
รักข้างเดียว

title.native: 妹の漫画をバズらせたいお兄ちゃんの話。
title.romaji: Imouto no Manga wo Brother Setai wo Niichan no Hanashi.

129262.description:
A notorious hit group whose existence itself is veiled, boasts considerable power among the mafia with their perfect workmanship.

In order to get those psychopaths with his own hands, Simone decided to enter the killers' den, just so he could avenge his sunbae. However not everything goes as planned...

129266.description:
No-eul is searching for the traitor in his organization, but finds only Gang-jin, a man who claims to just be a regular old vagrant. Intrigued by Gang-jin's cool demeanor even in the face of his threats, No-eul decides to keep him locked up for the time being. But there has to be more to Gang-jin than he is letting on... In the end, what secrets is he harboring and what are No-eul's true intentions?

(Source: Lezhin US)

129268.description:
Hakan is an orphan living in a beautiful island village. Sarah, the mysterious woman that saved Hakan, is called a goddess in the village ever since she managed to quell the angry waves.

One day, strangers from the Empire enter the peaceful and quiet island, and strangers start looking for Sarah...

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

129269.description:
When Kwon Yi-soo’s mom marries her long-term boyfriend, of course Yi-soo’s happy for her. But is it too much to ask that his new stepbrother not be his ex-fuckbuddy who is ALSO his boss, Han Gangjin? Yi-soo is desperate to stop him from revealing their relationship to their parents, but Gangjin doesn’t have the same qualms. He hadn’t been happy about Yi-soo breaking things off, after all. So Gangjin offers him a deal: they resume seeing each other in exchange for their parents’ blissful married life. But can that be all that Gangjin wants…?

(Source: Lezhin US)

129270.description:
Devout and gentle-hearted, Agatho firmly believes in the power of piety. When he met Noah six years ago, he instantly felt that leading the quiet boy towards religion would do him the world of good. His instincts were right—now, Noah has become an invaluable member of the church. While Agatho is proud of how Noah has changed, sometimes he does feel uncomfortable with the amount of trust the boy showers upon him. After all, the line between blind trust and dogged obsession is very, very thin...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Goro is introverted, but is also bursting with self-esteem. He has started doing pretend yaoi and is now looking for a partner! One day, his popular classmate comes out of nowhere and announces he wants to be his partner!

En has no prospects as a child of the slums—he ekes out a living by selling the scrap cyborg augmentations he scavenges to anyone who will buy. But when he's forced to go through some unethical experimentation, he transforms—making him eligible to become a fighter in the only thing that matters in this bleak world: The Rokudo Tournament!

129319.description:
Shinosuke is worked to the bone at his job at Kusonoya Hotel. After one tiring night, he stumbles into a stranger's apartment, thinking it was his own. When he awakes, he finds himself in the same bed with the stranger -the apartment's true resident- who speaks in a foreign language. Embarrassed, Shinosuke apologizes and tries to leave. The flustered Shinosuke sparks the stranger's interest, and the two end up having sex. Determined to leave it as a one-time thing, Shinosuke goes to work only to find that an overseas company buys the company he works at. And worse, the new general manager turns out to be Noah Shizuka Ishii -the stranger he just slept with.

(Source: Futekiya)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

129321.description:
Satsuki and Kippei are your regular coworkers. Kippei is Satsuki's subordinate and listens to his requests like handing out papers and... kissing him?! Correction: Satsuki and Kippei are NOT your regular coworkers. Their physical relationship started thanks to a mix-up with hotel rooms on a business trip, and since then, they have fulfilled each other's carnal needs and acted like friendly coworkers at the office. Satsuki starts wanting more with Kippei but decides it better to stay as they are to avoid ruining their relationship. But will they be able to stay work partners for long?

(Source: Futekiya)

129322.description:
Seita Okusu had always liked Kiyosawa. Like the shoujo manga he always reads, Seita wishes for a heartfelt romance with him, but Amane seems to always get in the way. Thinking that Amane also has feelings for Kiyosawa, Seita dubs him as his love rival. But Seita's dream of romance with Kiyosawa crumbles when Kiyosawa introduces his girlfriend to him. Heartbroken, Seita tries to move on by taking care of the garden Kiyosawa is now too busy to tend to. There, he finds Amane, who decided to water the withering plants. Seita then ropes Amane into looking after the garden with him thinking Amane is also heartbroken over Kiyosawa. But is he really?

(Source: Futekiya)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

129323.description:
Ayumu Satou, a bartender at Bar Crisis, hates how full-fledged adults suddenly lose all decency. A stickler for structure and following rules, Ayumu is not the typical 20- year-old college student. During his usual shift one day, a new face walks through the door, Yoshitaka Bandou. Immediately enticed, Ayumu tends to the new customer. Meeting a mischievous and devilish Yoshitaka, Ayumu becomes further intrigued. Upon the manager's return to the bar, the mood changes, and suddenly, Ayumu is left alone in the dark. What are they exactly? What is going on under the table? And why does Ayumu want to know more?

(Source: Futekiya)

129324.description:
He Xiao, an apprentice in a merchant shop, buys fox fur for the owner, but a fox demon falls on him and insists on being his wife... Under the tutelage of the fox demon, Fu Qing, He xiao aspires to become a a wealthy businessman in the human and demon world. He is forced to go on an exciting journey to discover the truth about demon hunting.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes 2 extras.

129325.description:
Song Chao found a ring that allowed him to freely travel between our world and a post-apocalyptic world. In the post-apocalyptic world, food was more valuable than gold, and there wasn't much left in that world except for gold! Song Chao has found the way to make it big! He took a tomato from his refrigerator at home and sold it for ten kilos of gold in the other world! You can even exchange food for beautiful women! You really think you can do whatever you want when you can offer food after the apocalypse? Yep, as long as you can offer food, you really can do whatever you want!

(Source: iQiyi, translated)

Yi’An High School’s youth will throw you into the story of the daily life of an all-boys school!

129327.description:
Tori, Ashi, and Chika are friends with a family-like dynamic. They gather for their regular drinking party and talk about Tori's usual carefree attitude, Ashi's usual denial of self and his narcissist boyfriend-not-boyfriend, and Chika's usual not getting any from his boyfriend of one year. Every day is a new update on each other's lives and how they all approach romance from extremely different angles.

(Source: Futekiya)

129329.description:
A nimble old man, Sagami Shirabe, has reincarnated into a body of a young boy with overpowered ability. However, he has reincarnated into a poor noble family, with a violent mother. On top of that, he gets exiled from the territory at 13... so now he is stuck in a weird situation.
"If that's the case, how about I just explore this world?" or so he thought.
With his abilities and past knowledge, he starts his adventure!

Yi Kui's got everything you could dream of... good looks, charisma, and style. After all, he's secretly a demon on the hunt for the best dreams to feast upon. Yi Kui can't believe his luck when he stumbles upon the new student—shy, sweet Lin You, who also happens to dream the most delectable nightmares. He immediately tries to charm Lin You, but none of his spells are working! Now Yi Kui's gotta beguile him the old-fashioned way... When Jiang Wanshu met Ren Pingsheng, what she thought was her light, became the beginning of her nightmare. As a teacher, Ren Pingsheng seems gentle and considerate on the outside, but is secretly an extremely passionate reader of Jiang Wanshu's book. What seemed to be a "coincidental" first encounter was in truth calculated and planned.

Behind the peaceful days, the crazy reader has begun her hunt...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

129344.description:
In a prosperous city, there are many races- which are beyond the understanding of humans- hidden in society. The strength and the prosperity of these races not only depends on their own growth, but also on human belief and worship of them.

However, as more people in modern society believe less in them, the more their numbers and strength diminish. Although there are still some powerful and ancient beings, they can only try their best to hide in corners of the world or pretend to be human.

On the other hand, there are other races with dark purposes who call themselves the "Devil Hunter Association". In order not to be discovered by the demon hunters and not targeted by humans, various races worked hard to integrate into human society.

129345.description:

129384.description:
Detached. Disinterested. Dispassionate. All words used to describe Su-Hyeon and his uneventful, mediocre life. He's nothing like he once was. As a teen, he had a fire, a passion burning within, all thanks to one person: bright-haired and brilliant Eun-Seong. Throughout high school, Su-Hyeon obsessively competed with Eun-Seong for the top spot in all things, only to consistently come in second place. And as high school ended without victory, so did his passion for anything. But all this changes when, as an adult, he suddenly sees Eun-Seong again—except the other man is in the news, embroiled in scandal! Seeing Eun-Seong in a state of shame ignites something in Su-Hyeon. Fiery hate, long thought dead, comes alive within him once more.

Determined to see a fallen Eun-Seong with his own eyes, Su-Hyeon reinvents himself as a reporter and begins dishing out one dirty article after another. He's sure that with each scathing article, Eun-Seong will come crawling to Su-Hyeon and begging for mercy. Except, it doesn't happen. Eun-Seong doesn't react at all the way Su-Hyeon expects! Just who is being manipulated, and who, the manipulator?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment, edited)

Note: Includes 11 extra chapters.

129389.description:
When ex-mercenary Gyuwon Kim returns to Korea after his retirement, he has just one goal in mind: earn enough money to get plastic surgery. While having a face that is capable of making even a grown man cry in fear came in handy as a mercenary, what Gyuwon really wants is to be the one crying himself at the hands of a ruthless master. The perfect opportunity comes when Gyuwon is hired as a bodyguard to protect the precious youngest son of the Yoon Clan, Hwayoung Yoon, from a recent stalker. Unbeknownst to Gyuwon, hidden behind Hwayoung’s pretty face is actually a sadistic dom who already has plans to make the vicious-looking man his new pet.

(Source: Tappytoon)

129393.description:
In a world where humans and human-like beasts coexist, Yukari comes across an unconscious Shima in the streets. When Shima wakes, he finds himself in a warm bath, being washed by his savior, Yukari. Shima, prejudiced against humans, starts thinking maybe not all humans are bad until he sees Yukari's scar, the same scar of one of the humans that took Yuki away. Shima, desperate to find Yuki, barges into the underground shop Yukari owns that offers special services from beast to humans. Lo and behold, Yuki is there but is not wanting to go home as Shima imagined. Will Shima be able to return to his village empty-handed? Or will he have to stay in the shop and... work there?

(Source: Futekiya)

129395.description:
I-Tae Jung, a Beta, suddenly finds himself being pursued by Dan Ge-Um, a rich and famous Alpha from his school. They say an Alpha can never truly be attracted to a Beta, but considering the strange offers Dan keeps making to get closer to I-Tae… Is it just a hormonal malfunction, or could it be real love?

129396.description: The mortal, Ya Xuan, had wandered around in all four directions. A mortal and a demon became companions, marking the start of an endless journey through the vast wilderness. A person who seeks for immortality, the evil spirit who massacres without a care, the cold-hearted god, the magnificent Ying Zhou's prisoner cage… Amidst the vast wilderness, a thrilling anecdote was painted across Ya Xuan's picture scroll. The countless of years revealed more and more secrets. Who actually is Ya Xuan? Why does he not age nor die? Why was the Blood Sea Phantom Sparrow's clan exterminated and condemend by the Nine Heavens? What is Ya Xuan's true goal…?

129403.description:
After growing up in poverty, Daon has worked his butt off to avoid worrying about money now that he’s on his own. But his penny-pinching ways are affecting more than him—his co-worker Sunghyeon has totally had it with Daon! While Daon is mostly unaware of Sunghyeon’s detestation and mood, an incident at work changes everything. When Daon’s impoverished parents show up at his job, begging for money, Sunghyeon witnesses everything, and suddenly their relationship changes.

As the two grow closer, Daon must also wrestle with the feelings he has for his former tutor and mentor, Jaemin, as well as a huge secret he’s kept from everyone!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Chapter count includes 5 side story chapters.

129406.description:
In the barren northern Snowlands of the empire, a war that has raged on for 37 years against the vicious Norcans is finally brought to an end by one Captain Sahara Ellawood of the 128th Order. When Crown Prince Cheshire Wi Solante goes to escort Captain Ellawood to the capital, he expects to find a savage who beheads and eats the eyes of her enemies. But to his surprise, Captain Ellawood is an incredibly strong, loyal, innocent, and most importantly, beautiful woman. Cheshire is instantly enamored with Sahara, and the two spend an intimate night together after the victory party. But things quickly turn sour when Sahara claims that the only feeling she harbors for the prince is devout loyalty. Will Cheshire be able to break down Sahara's walls and captivate this charming knight's heart?

(Source: Tappytoon)

129407.description:
Chansol never experienced friendship before he met Park Hanhoo, a troubled boy who terrifies school gangs and hides his face with an unruly haircut. But when a horrific event turns Chansol's world upside down, he is forced into hiding and reneges on his promise to stay by Hanhoo's side. Now an adult, he’s back to resolve old issues, but with the truth about his past hidden behind a world of mafia bosses and shady business, his only option is to infiltrate it as the manager of an unhinged arms dealer. As Chansol sets out to coax information out of his new boss, he realizes that seducing this handsome maniac may just bring him closer to the truth and the friend he used to call Park Hanhoo.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Chapter count includes an epilogue

129408.description:
Mikuni is a snake beast folk who was constantly bullied as a child due to his beast nature. His only friend and defender was Nachi, a quarter lion beast folk who always tells Mikuni that he's pretty. Mikuni's feelings for Nachi have always been more than just friends and became stronger as they grew up. Now grown-up, Mikuni is undergoing his shedding phase, which makes him emit pheromones. This proves to be troublesome as it makes any person, beast or not, attracted to him. He's only ever wanted Nachi. When Mikuni learns that his bite may have a chance of bewitching someone, he tries it on Nachi. Will his bite make Nachi want him? Also contains two side stories: "The Sweetest Bite in the World": A story between the Professor and his ward, Takumi, a track team member. "Catch the Goddess by the Tail": The story between senior track member and former ace, Aihachi, and the current track ace, Shunsuke.

(Source: Futekiya)

title.native: 甘噛みだけではすまさないっ

129409.description:
In a world ruled by magic, the stronger the magic power, the closer the hair color to the color of moonlight, and the weaker the magic power, the darker and more subdued the hair. Ashley, with her sooty, brick-red hair, is excellent at the study of magic, but her magic power is extremely weak, so she has been unable to fulfill of her dream of becoming a mage.

In the end, Ashley was granted temporary mage status by her mentor, the Secretary of the Ministry of Magic Education, but in exchange she is asked to train an imprisoned young man with immense magical power that no one with magical power can even touch...?! A young man in solitary confinement and a second-rate mage. It's a mysterious gender-reversed Rapunzel love-story by a promising new author!

Notes:
- The first volume includes an epilogue about what happened to the main characters after the last chapters of the first part.
- It was announced on December 27, 2021 that the manga will resume serialization on January 21, 2022 due to its popularity.
- Chapter count includes 4 extras.

Suganuma Eijiro, the painter who's rumored if he draws living person then he steals the person's souls, or if he draws dead person then the person revives. He's called as Nue Painter. What clients think when they request to him? He finishes his drawings with connection of clients' each memories, What's facing him then?

Human Drama with deep old period theme and neat style.

Step into the wild terrain, where nature blazes with fervor! Picture this: two souls, worlds apart, cross paths on the untamed savannah of Africa. What epic saga will they script amidst Africa's pulsating heart?

(Source: WebComics)

129412.description:
“Wake up.”

These are the words Sora Han hears right before her heart stops and then begins to beat again. The first and only person in the world to successfully have a plant heart transplant, Sora has felt an inexplicable pull to go to outer space ever since her operation. At 25 years old, she finally gets the chance. But why does everything on the planet she travels to seem familiar? Sora learns more about herself on this journey than she could have ever imagined.

(Source: WEBTOON)

129413.description: Sayaka, a kindergarten teacher, has to start doing adult work to cover the moving expenses after her boyfriend left her.  However, her very first customer as a call girl is none other than the parent of one of her student...?!  Andou-san raises his son on his own and takes him to school every day. Such a kind man, he tells Sayaka take her pay and go home without doing anything. Sayaka refuses, and now Andou-san is going to 'touch her until the time is up'.

Ertha Arlez is an impoverished purifier looking to provide for her family. Duke Zahid El Callenor is a wealthy and powerful magician looking to cleanse his evil energy. The two seem like a perfect match… except that Zahid is fated to eat Ertha alive! Ertha must keep the duke at arm’s length for her own protection, but the intimate purification process combined with Zahid’s nonstop flirting make that nearly impossible. Can she stave him off and stay alive, or will she be consumed by passion?

(Source: Tapas)

A long-time favorite among students for his excellent lectures and kindness, it seems like he has everything a man would wish for. But even he had a little secret - Jaeyoung is a big-time otaku of magical girl animes. Then one day, a student of his, Saewoong, finds him holding a dakimakura, effectively exposing Jaeyoung's otaku lifestyle. Desperate to keep his double life a secret, Jaeyoung agrees on a deal with Saewoong that would shake his life...

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

The boy-band-turned-writer, Lin, receives an offer to have his book turned into a film from Yeon Seoho, a former fellow band member. Lin declines at first but decides to leave it to a bet. If Seoho can satisfy him on 5 dates, then he'd give them permission. And so, a business arrangement begins between the two with the bet depending on Seoho's performance.

Police officer Ma Young-Tae thinks he’s in for a long dry spell after being transferred to the countryside with only old people for miles. But a trip to the neighborhood cleaners ends in Young-Tae getting more than just his laundry done when he finds Seo Dae-Hyeon, the only other young man in the village, in a compromising position. They strike a deal where both of them get down and dirty…

Things get naughty fast when his male sleep companion forces himself onto him. Satoshi's editor, Tatsumi, recognizes Yoh and instantly becomes jealous as he secretly has a crush on Satoshi. Eun Chong, a descendant of Ji Gwi, found that by touching the Hong Kong exchange student Hae Bum, his body temperature lowers. Masashi is an erotic game maniac. Today he starts playing games as usual. But when he comes back to his room with a roll of toilet paper, he finds the beautiful Prince Suquarthur standing in front of the PC screen as if he just pops out from the game. The prince of Isekai with horns and a tail asks Masashi, "You, the legendary human... Take me for yourself." Why does the prince comes here at all? And what is his purpose? Being the new kid in school is never easy. Especially not for a wallflower like Eun-jae, who has spent most of his childhood in and out of hospitals because of his weak heart. Now, his only wish is to live and experience life as a normal high schooler. Unfortunately, the high school experience for him not only means attending classes and making friends, but also getting bullied for looking like an omega. But things aren’t all bad. Not when you consider his regular encounters with Jin-hyeon, the popular kid in school. As accidents and coincidences keep bringing them together, Eun-jae realizes he had met Jin-hyeon a long time ago… even if the latter doesn’t remember. And although a throbbing heart has always been a cause for concern, Eun-jae discovers a heart can throb for sweeter reasons too.

At 78 years old, Midran, an archmage, has at least a solid 50 years left to live. That’s more than enough time to reach the infamous 8th circle—a place only archmages dream to go. At present, it’s a journey that requires an enormous amount of mana and has proven to be physically impossible time and time, again. But alas, that’s a problem for another day. Sleep comes first.

Then, he wakes up. Only it turns out he passed away in his slumber and has awoken in his next life as a child named Hyeon?! What the hell happened while he was asleep? And where did all his hard-earned mana go?!

(Source: Comikey)
