32-34. Daeum Seukejureun 2501Hoeseo (다음 스케줄은 2501호에서; Next Meeting is in Room 2501) by Hui-Yeol Park

129432.description: A short story about a town where everything that's been lost always returns.

title.native: なくしたものはなんですか

129434.description:
Inspired by the novel "Crime and Punishment" by Fyodor Dostoevsky.

Note: Published in AX Volume 1: A Collection of Alternative Manga.

129436.description: Unemployed, and with no fixed address, Meguru Watanuki always shows up at his friend Kaname Tatsumi’s door whenever he finds himself flat broke. Meguru is in love with Kaname, but has no intention of telling him, lest it ruin their comfortable relationship. Then one day, while doing a delivery job offered to him by a shady stranger, Meguru lands himself in hot water and is force-fed some very dubious drugs. Though he manages to make his foggy way home, he is unable to contain his drug-induced excitement, and ends up assaulting Kaname in his sleep...!

title.native: バカな犬ほど愛おしい

129437.description:
Lee Susu, an easy-going girl who lived in the countryside all the time since she was a child. She had no choice but to stay at his brother, Lee Han's house after the high school in the village was closed. And there are big and small misunderstandings between the awkward siblings...

(Source: Pocket Comics)
synonyms: 與哥哥同住的那些小事
Yu Gege Tongzhu de Naxie Xiaoshi

129440.description:
Eunsu is not happy that his mother’s new boyfriend has sons—a pair of twins at that. What was his mother thinking leaving out that important bit of information?! And when his mother tells him she might just marry the man, Eunsu is dead against it. But Eunsu’s trouble ensues when the twins are more than determined to win their new ‘hyung’ over and lend him a helping hand to change his mind. Will Eunsu give in and be bound to them in more-than-familial ties, or will he stay steadfast in his decision?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes two side stories.

129441.description:
Jaehyun has had a huge secret crush on his friend Woojin for the past seven years. But seeing Woojin fall in love with someone else is breaking his heart. Jaehyun tells this all to Seungtae, his online friend who knows all about his secret crush. While on a call with Seungtae, Jaehyun meets a handsome cashier with an oddly familiar voice. Will Jaehyun forever be doomed to talk about his love life like it’s something he’s heard from someone else? Or will he finally find a happier story of his own to tell?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: The chapter count includes 10 side story chapters.
synonyms: The Story of Someone I Know

129442.description: No one in the world stops, everything flows endlessly. In the future society of rapid technological development, an oasis of human emotional desert-"Changzhou", tens of billions of people are online at the same time, and a large-scale once-in-a-decade event has been launched around this virtual world. competition. In the complicated and confusing game world, Kai Thief X and Master Yu chase each other like meteors, turning into shining trails, flying across the civilized night sky. The sparks are lit one by one, the heroes awaken one after another, and a violent storm of rebuilding the civilized world has already begun.

129443.description:
A gay son and a lesbian daughter.
Jin and Rin are best friends, and they each have a secret - they are both gay. Life turns upside down when both of their households find out about their sexual orientation. How will they survive despite their parents knowing?

(Source: Manta)

129444.description:
MC tries to buy some alcohol but gets mistaken as a minor by the male lead because of the way she's dressed. She is unable to provide verification of her age as she left her ID at home, furthering the misunderstanding that she's younger.

They meet again at school and it turns out that he's a student at the school where she will be teaching. Although she's already late to work, he gets in her way. When asked why she wasn't wearing a uniform, she lies and says she's a transfer student instead of telling him the truth like a normal person. After getting attracted to him, she now uses that lie to disguise as a high schooler so that she can meet him.

129445.description: He was a part of the top 10 players in the beta test for "Sword Dance Online", but when he was put into a vegetative state after the car accident, he became a monster in the game. After endless amounts of time spent getting stronger, he soon struck terror to the noobs of the server and encountered affectionate situations with countless women.

129446.description: "She who is afraid of water, what kind of love song will she compose when she meets him who is wandering in the sea?" One day, Areum received a phone call saying that she had a younger brother who was adopted to France? That man is also a world-renowned diving expert! What exactly is going on?

129447.description:
After celebrating her new job at her favorite idol Chan Lee’s company, Da-Reum wakes up to a nightmare: the man she drunkenly attacked while defending her oppa is actually Hagi Kang, the company’s CEO. And Chan? He barely comes to the office at all. With only one shot at seeing Chan up close, an exclusive overseas company retreat, Da-Reum tries to cozy up to Hagi. But her attempts to stay on the CEO’s good side only convince him that she’s fallen for him. Even worse, Chan mistakes her nerves for hostility when they finally meet. A fangirl, two powerful men, and one growing misunderstanding. Da-Reum’s dream romance might end before it even begins.

(Source: WEBTOON)

129448.description:
Same place, different time — A time slip romance!

“What does it matter if we have a 70-year age difference?” Jinha, an office worker who is traumatized from the bullying in her past, receives a mysterious message from the future... A time slip story of fantasy and romance transcending time and space.

(Source: Manta)

129449.description:
Touma, the next in line to succeed as the head of the Hyuga Group, spends his days beating up street punks and chasing after pretty women.
However, everything changes when his father, the head of the group, assigns him a new bodyguard. His bodyguard proclaims: "I am ready to sacrifice my everything for you no matter what the cost," yet what is he hiding from the young master?

129450.description:
After quitting his job just to end up scammed out of all his money, Yim Sang-Tae's at the end of his rope! He hangs around a luxurious apartment building and throws himself at the first rich person he sees, begging for a meal. But his savior, Mo Yeon-Woo, asks how Sang-Tae will pay him back. When Sang-Tae states he'll use his body, intending to do manual labor, Yeon-Woo agrees and they wind up in bed together! Will Sang-Tae and Yeon-Woo find happiness in their sudden encounter, or will Sang-Tae's debts catch up to him?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes seven extra chapters.
synonyms: 助けてください、おじさん！

129451.description:
Are you satisfied...with just meeting me?

(Source: Fakku!)

Published in Comic Kairakuten 2021-02

129452.description: Airi Hirakawa, an active model in a popular women's magazine, suddenly faints in front of her house and get abducted by a man. She wakes up in a room surrounded by garbage and get proposed by Hirokazu Imai, a man who seems to be her stalker and her kidnapper. She will then suffer from sexual violence every single day and won't get to eat or go to the toilets by herself. Why is this happening to her?
synonyms: A Monstrous Person’s Time: Madness Syndrome
Time for Beasts: Mad Codependecy Syndrome

title.native: けだものたちの時間～狂依存症候群～

129453.description: Lee Hyunsung is taking care of his three younger siblings on his own. He’s tall, attractive, has a good body, but his only downside is that he’s as poor as he can be. On the other hand, Kim Garam is a businessman who gets captivated by Hyunsung’s body. Can these two people be connected, even if a huge gap separates them?

129454.description:
Unrequited love bloomed for Jaewon Shin on the courts of an elite tennis training camp, but his feelings for his arrogant but irresistible practice mate, Javier, are as doomed as Jaewon’s tennis career. Years later, with a permanent knee injury and no prospects, Jaewon is stunned to find his old crush, His Excellency, Duke Javier Leoncino himself, at his door with a marriage proposal. Jaewon’s met his match for this love game.

(Source: Tapas)

129455.description:
Oh Chris who became Top Star Cheon Jaesung's stylist one morning, meets him for the first time with huge expectations. However, unlike his screen image, he doesn't know a thing about fashion! To teach him about fashion Chris goes to his house and he discovers something very surprising...?

Soon, Chris learns about Jaesung's secret and now his heart won't stop pounding.

129456.description: A brilliant hitman buys his freedom with the money he earned at work. Sakaki got a new name, as suggested by his former boss. He adopted a child to form a family, but ——…!?
synonyms: キラー ペアレント

129457.description:
"No... I'm gonna cum!!" The usually-indifferent girl changes completely! To think she could be so erotic, cute and honest with an aphrodisiac...

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Each chapter is split into 3 ‘episodes’ in the long strip format, resulting in a total of 9 episodes.

129458.description:
Gyu-Heon goes on a vacation with his girlfriend, Da-Eun, to a guest house hidden in the countryside. However, from the moment they encounter the owner of the guest house upon their arrival, everything starts to fall apart. As horrible events start to unfold along with dreadful encounters, they continue to fall deeper into the darkest pit of hell... It’s time to put an end to everything.

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

129459.description: When you’re clamping down this hard, what don’t you like about this? The nursery school I work for is in danger of shutting down after receiving a notice from the city hall. As a graduate of this school, I had to do something so I reached out to the person in charge, Shinomiya-San. I was supposed to get advice on how to save the school, but for some reason I’m in his room doing lewd things…Even though I only wanted advice I’m entranced by his eyelashes and enticing smell. His kiss is so erotic my brain feels like it’s melting and his slightest touch makes me wet…Although I came for advice, I ended up getting teased until morning. Even though city officials shouldn’t be like this, I only feel pleasure

Have you ever gotten that eerie feeling that someone's watching you? That when you turn off the lights, you're not alone? Read these terrifying ghost stories and try not to scream.

A collection of stories by Korea's master of horror, Horang:

129469.description: In the near future, the education system has evolved into a military competition between youths over the domination of others. The stakes are high here: the winner takes all from the loser. Schools are now mobile buildings that host their students, which are able to summon weapons of varying power and shape to battle each other. Mabaram starts from the bottom in this system and won't let his school, Metro, go down without a fight. He will have to pair up with an unexpected transfer student to assimilate other schools in order to reach the tallest heights of the rankings.

129482.description:
Outgoing and athletic, Da-Rim’s always surrounded by friends. But back in elementary school, she used to be a social outcast—she only started making friends when Tae-Hoo brought her into the fold. Now in high school, the two have drifted apart, but Da-Rim is waiting for a chance to reunite with her icy Prince Charming. There’s just one issue: Da-Rim's body transforms into a boy’s at noon every day, only to turn back at midnight! Well, if she can’t get close to Tae-Hoo as a girl… Why not try as a boy?!

(Source: Lezhin)

129483.description:
"I know you won’t be satisfied with anyone but me."

I know we shouldn’t be doing this... But when his tongue licks those places I can’t help but want it somewhere deeper.

One day, Karen realizes that she’s been reincarnated as the villainess in an otome game. Furthermore, following the plotline, her engagement to the prince will be broken and her family ruined. In order to avoid the worst end, she locks up her feelings towards the prince’s bodyguard, her childhood friend Hansel. But one day Hansel saves her when she’s in a tight spot and her locked up feelings start to overflow. He passionately kisses her while saying “Forget about this”, but her heart and body are already his.

129484.description:
It began with la mort d'amour.
When a rich old man croaks during a passionate round of bedroom escapades, So-Heon is accused of being his partner. Not long after, Seo-Ho, the CEO of the company So-Heon works for, presents him with a video of the incident... and makes him an offer just can't refuse.

(Source: Manta, edited)

129485.description:
"I just need to take care of one alpha."

Omega Jian, a researcher at the U.S. Genetic Research Institution, will be in charge of managing the lab's cash cow and the excellent Alpha "Adam Barrett," who possesses both the body and the intelligence. Barrett's plight as a stallion and selling himself to unwanted partners keep Jian weakened and he ends up unintentionally helping him to run away.

But... Was he just pretending to be someone in need?! Can Jian tame Barret, someone who messes around and plays with the people in his lab?!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

129486.description: Anthologies included with the special editions of Ueno-san wa Bukiyou.

129487.description:
Every cat has a purpose in life, or a passion. We poor humans are quite ignorant. We find ourselves envying them, sometimes pitying them, or being moved. In any case, after reading this, we will think twice before reducing a tomcat to a vulgar ball of fur.

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

129488.description:
Kazuma Inoue and Otoha Mizuki inspire each other to pursue their dreams. Hurdling for Kazuma and singing for Otoha.

129500.description:
Aspiring police officer Makoto is currentingly paying his dues at the Kabukicho police substation. Bustling Kabukicho is no walk in the park, especially with customer-luring Ren. Makoto struggles to stay professional in the face of this hooligan. After a drunken night, he awakens to a pleasant, but confusing, surprise from Ren.

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: The Hooligan and the Night Patrol

title.native: あの子は死にたがりヴァンプ

129502.description: On one rainy day, high school girl Komae Shouko learns that her classmate, Katagiri Sui, has a special ability.

129504.description:
Rachel only became the fiancée of the Prince due to her high magic power. That’s why when the Saint appeared, she feared that her position would be taken away from her.

As a punishment for her vile deed against the Saint, her engagement was annulled and she was banished to the monastery. But on the way to the monastery, she was attacked by bandits. Just as Rachel thought she was about to die, she suddenly woke up and found out that she had returned to three years ago.

However, she no longer had her high magic power and became so sickly that she could hardly even sit up in her bed. Rachel was just happy that she was alive and decided to cancel the engagement; yet for some reason, the Prince refused!?
synonyms: Somehow, The Villainess Who Regressed in Time Lost Her Magic Power, so She Turned into a Secluded Maiden
The Villainess Who Traveled Back in Time Inexplicably Lost Her Magic, So She Went into Seclusion

129505.description: All pure-hearted Mamoru Hishida wants is to live as a decent human being. So he can’t figure out why his life keeps spiralling out of control. Then one night, he happens upon a beautiful vampire who immediately recognizes him for what he truly is —an incubus—human hybrid, and on the brink of sexual starvation. The vampire strikes a bargain with Mamoru to become his familiar in exchange for a supply of sexual energy... But are familiars usually charged with attending manga conventions? Thus begins a strange romance between a virgin incubus and a sensual, manga-obsessed vampire.

title.native: ゆめみるヴァンパイア

129506.description: "Magic." A sacred mystery usable only by those chosen. One day, a child from the slums named Arus finds he has the power to use magic. A sorcerer by the name of Genos Willzard learns of his talent and raises him, turning him into the greatest of assassins. One day, Genos gives him an order: To enroll at the Magic Academy...!?

129511.description:
Kyousuke Ageki, a fat guy with a big appetite, has always been interested in Itsuha Mitsukura, a girl who doesn't stand out in his class. He comes across her alone on the rooftop after school, exposing her erotic body in an extreme swimsuit! Kyousuke finds out Itsuha's unexpected secret...!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title.native: エロティック×アナボリック

129512.description:
The Odin Mainland is separated into four counties, in each lives a group of soul masters protecting their county with their soul powers. The most powerful seven of them are known as Noble Lords. The story begins in the water origin, the Aslan Empire.
Qi Ling has been a busboy in an inn ever since he was young and subconsciously tamed a legendary soul beast Cang Xue Zhi Ya in a battle between soul masters. Yin Chen came on orders of the Silver Priests to take in him as his disciple. With his help, Qi Ling heads to the Grave of the Souls to seek his soul weapon, yet as he couldn’t sit still like how his lord instructed him, he enters the Grave of the Souls with Tianshu Youhua and Guishen Lianquan.
After his risky adventure in the Grave of the Souls, he was scolded by his lord. At the very same time, another conspiracy that has long been in the works within the Aslan Empire is gradually revealing itself.

129513.description: Yuri, who lost her dog Natsukichi three years ago, is studying to become a veterinarian. One day, she rescued a stray dog from the side of the road and brought it home. While taking care of the dog she’s reminded of nostalgic memories of Natsukichi. When she woke up, she saw a handsome guy sleeping next to her. Her deceased pet dog came back in the form of a human?! And wants to have XXX with her!?

129514.description:
For three years, Wen Nian'nan had tried hard to make their marriage work. But all he got in return were cold shoulders and physical scars from his spouse, Gu Yansheng. It was not until he discovered his broken wedding ring was a fake that he decided to give up. "Gu Yansheng, I shall walk away from your life as you wish." A few months later, when Yansheng finally learned the truth and tried to win Nian'nan back, he was greeted with an icy smirk. Will Nian'nan forgive him for the excruciating pain he caused?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes prologue and one extra chapter.
synonyms: He Said I Am Black Lotus

title.romaji: Ta Shuo Wo Shi Hei Lianhua

129515.description:
Yu Qianyi, who is always careful to please other people’s lives on campus, often feels that his future is bleak, until he meets Cai Peixi, a boy who is completely opposite to him. By chance, the two have an indissoluble bond. The story of healing and growth of youth unfolds...

(Source: Kuaikan Manhua, translated)

129516.description:
When the prince was on the verge of death, he saw not only the moon in the sky, but also a vampire with a beautiful face. The human prince, who was saved by the vampire, decided to repay his kindness. Little did the vampire expect there would be a day he would be involved with a human!

A warm smile suddenly appeared in the endless life of the vampire, and the loneliness of being imprisoned began to change from the day they met~

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

129517.description:
Trash? A good-for-nothing who can't awaken his fighting spirit? A disgrace to the Luo family name? The biggest joke in Wuling province? All of this just makes him laugh!
He was spurned by his family, hated by his father, and even strangers made fun of him! Eventually, he was disowned and kicked out of the house! But losing everything caused him to become enlightened! He realized that, on the Fighting Spirit Mainland, only the strong are respected!
When his former talent returned, what others saw as genius was nothing more than a joke to him.
They call him a demon? He responds:
"Hehe, what I, Luo Chen, love to abuse most is evil!"

(Source: Kuaikan Manhua, translated)

129518.description:
1-4. Mittomonai Koi
5. Koishii Kobushi
6. Dare ni mo Narenai
7. Seishounen Ryuu Violence
8. Seishounen Ryuu Resistance
9. Seishounen Ryuu Monopoly

129519.description:
An unknown streamer Long Jieran fed a stranger on his way home from the supermarket, then he found the stranger got symptoms of food poisoning! Long Jieran, who had originally wanted to leave returned at the end because of the stings of conscience. And he helped the self-proclaimed homeless canine orc Xibo.

"If we can share the rent, everything will be good".

(Source: Webnovel)

Note: Chapter count includes an extra.

title.native: 巧克力于犬是禁止事项
title.romaji: Chocolate Yu Quan shi Jinzhi Shixiang

129520.description:
An evil secret society called the Black Cross Army threatens world peace, and only an elite task force known as the Earth Guard League (EAGLE) can stop them. After the Black Cross Army destroys EAGLE’s headquarters across Japan, only five young recruits survive. Hiding in a secret underground base, they are given enhanced battlesuits that empower them with superhuman abilities, transforming the youths into an unstoppable squad to combat evil.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: SUPER SENTAI: Himitsu Sentai Gorenger – The Classic Manga Collection

title.native: 秘密戦隊ゴレンジャー

129521.description:
Lady-killer Qin You'an is caught on camera visiting a production set. The peanut gallery: Mr. Qin must have been there to see the gorgeous Wen Tingyue. Ohhh, they are such a perfect match. Wen Tingyue's fans repost on Weibo, examine details, retouch photos, and imagine Wen Tingyue and Qin You'an being lovey dovey. But when a little-known actor named Shen Suyun is photographed throwing himself at Mr. Qin later on by the paparazzi, all netizens flare up: How dare this lowly nobody touch Mr. Qin?!

(Source: WeComics)
synonyms: The Nation's Husband is Secretly Married

129522.description:
Ilic has committed the perfect crime—or so he thought. After killing his boss’s son in self-defense, Ilic is soon found out by none other than Grand Duke Sa-yan. The duke is gracious enough to allow Ilic keep his secret…as long as Ilic expresses his gratitude by begging the duke to bed him. And if Ilic refuses, his life may be endangered by his boss’s wrath. Now entirely at Sa-yan’s mercy, Ilic is forced to embark on an affair that involves much more than he bargained for: acts of indecency, political intrigue, and maybe even love.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 20 extra chapters.
synonyms: Plaything: The Toy of a Grand Duke
プレイシング〜とある大公閣下のおもちゃ〜
Plaything: El juguete del Gran Duque
Plaything : ของเล่นของแกรนด์ดยุก

129523.description:
Repent, or face hell on Earth! In Seoul, apparitions have started appearing before those who have done wrong to notify them of when they will die. A new religious group explains these happenings as God condemning people to make them live more righteously. Detective Jin is assigned to investigate the latest incident, just as his wife’s murderer is scheduled to be released from prison.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Notes:
- Includes four extra chapters.
- Source of the Netflix drama of the same name released in November 2021.

129524.description:
Hwan, a college student, is introduced to a part time job of babysitting.
To his surprise, Nabi, his employer, makes a move on him on his first night of work.
He is even more surprised when Nabi seems to casually brush off this encounter and signs him on for work.

So begins a peculiar working environment, as Hwan starts to care for Yoojoo, Nabi's son, and things get more personal and complicated between Hwan and Nabi

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Note: The chapter count includes a prologue.
synonyms: Shh, You'll Wake up the Child

129525.description: Dynamic Heroes is a digital manga by Kazuhiro Ochi that presents the most notable characters from the franchises by Dynamic Productions in their anime format in a massive crossover. It involves the series: Devilman, Mazinger Z, Cutey Honey, Great Mazinger, Getter Robo, Grendizer, Demon Lord Dante and Dororon Enma-kun.
synonyms: Go Nagai Manga Heroes Crossover Collection - Dynamic Heroes

title.native: 永井豪まんが外伝 ダイナミックヒーローズ
title.romaji: Nagai Go Manga Gaiden: Dynamic Heroes

129526.description:
"I want you."

Lily, the daughter of a fallen aristocrat has never held a sword in her life. But Charles, the new king of Ryslim wants to hire her as his personal swordswoman?! Charles, a man with many enemies, was attacked at his coronation party. Lily, who drew his sword and rescued him in one fell swoop, impressed Charles with her swift reflexes and was forced to become his swordswoman exclusively. Little by little, Lily begins to recall memories from her previous life, in which sword-wielding was...
A refreshing, other-worldly court story depicting incredible sword techniques and characters falling into clumsy love!

(Source: Pocket Comics)

title.native: 異世界で宮廷剣士はじめます

129527.description:
"Some thoughts can't be spoken, so we can only let them rot in our hearts and bear it alone." Faced with a repressed life, debt that falls upon him out of nowhere, and the confused feelings between two teenagers... How will the youthful them face all of this? This is the other side of youth, the story you don't know.

Childhood friends Seyun and Yoojin struggle to maintain their friendship as their lives take them down different paths. But when old feelings start resurfacing, a bitter tug-of-war starts, with hearts in the balance, secrets in the closet, and twists that nobody sees coming!

title.romaji: Ni Suo Bu Zhidao de Wo

129528.description:
Mazinger Z is an alternate telling manga made in collaboration with Gosaku Ōta and Go Nagai, compared to the original and TV Magazine manga by Nagai, this manga was made more in tune with the anime while adding its own original elements.

The manga focuses on a plot more similar to the anime starting with Koji checking on his grandfather after Baron Ashura had activated a bomb. With his dying breath, Dr. Kabuto gives Koji the Super Robot Mazinger Z. With the threat of Dr. Hell looming, Koji fights against his Mechanical Beasts and lieutenants with help from Sayaka Yumi and to some degree Boss.

129529.description: A boy, who longed for the legends of Elves, will finally have his dream realised.

129530.description:
Genius player x industry elite.

After five years, the innocent and shy junior in Li Moyang's memory disappeared, and he suddenly became an advertising genius known as the "No. 1 Fox in the business world". Faced with the signing request of his ex-boyfriend, Li Moyang decided to launch a "full revenge" on him, and it would be best if he would lie at his feet and beg for mercy!

He thought he could avenge his previous shame, but he didn't expect to fall into the trap of the "fox". When he found out, he was already deeply trapped and couldn't extricate himself... With his left hand doing business and his right hand falling in love, let's see the passionate story of the two people loving and killing each other, fighting wits and courage!

(Source: Manman Manhua, translated)

title.romaji: San Ge Huangyan Yi Ge Wen

synonyms: The Female Teacher Who Fights Back

title.romaji: Nixi Zhi Wu Liang Nü Jiaoshi

129532.description:
Ken’s life is ordinary. He’s a former orphan, he works as a server in a pub, and he lives on the outskirts of Aman, a religious nation free from the influence of vampires. Then one day, Ken is bitten and cursed by a vampire, and is only saved from certain death by Agia Frederick, a powerful disciple of the Church. However, freeing Ken from his curse requires a physical intimacy with Agia, who seems to have ulterior motives for keeping Ken around… Will the relationship between the two men bloom into something more? Or will it be crushed and burned entirely?

(Source: Lezhin US)

129533.description:
Coffee-loving Yoon Bom-Sol has been struggling ever since her beloved business, Cafe Bom, went under. When she lands a job as assistant to Jake K., an arrogant but sought-after barista, she has no idea that he is really Kim Jae-Hee, a customer of hers who proposed to her almost a decade ago. Reunited once again in the world of coffee, will Bom-Sol see Jaehee for the man he’s trying to be? Or will this second encounter be a “latte” to handle?

(Source: Tapas, edited)
synonyms: ฤดูใบไม้ผลิรสเอสเปรสโซ

129534.description:
At first glance, Ji-hoon and Yu-min appear to be good neighbours, but they look different from behind.
The two became sex partners to relieve sexual desire, and Ji-hoon always loves Yu-min unrequitedly, but Yoo-min is thinking of cutting off this relationship one day.

(Source: Lezhin, Translated)

129535.description:
In a crazy turn of events, Sera, an office worker, is stranded on a remote island and captured by a native tribe. A mysterious Tarzan-esque man rescues her, but it turns out he’s also on the run. As they flee the tribes that are after them, Sera develops a special power she can’t quite understand. She also feels attracted to the strange man...

(Source: Manta)

129536.description:
A the terrible murder surrounding a broadcast jockey involving the video editor-in-charge... What is the truth behind it?

(Source: Daum Webtoon, translated)

129537.description:
How about talking to someone? Eating alone today? You never know what's going to happen!

(Source: Toomics)

129538.description:
Just an ordinary female high school student Liao Yuqing bumped into a Prince Charming classmate on her way to school?! At the same time, the center-of-attention rabid American exchange student Ryan and infamously scary devil student Chu Feng met. Surrounded by these four, the ordinary girl and her strange and unique classmates have had a hilarious campus life ever since.

(Source: Kuaikan Manhua, translated)
synonyms: My Classmates are All Very Strange

title.romaji: Wo de Tongxue Dou Hen Qiguai

A collection of short stories of Bobobo-related tales.

1. Sanchuushuu Katsugeki (山中臭活劇)
2. Bobobo-bo Bo-bobo: Akamaru Jump Version (ボボボーボ・ボーボボ 赤マルバージョン)
3-6. Bobobo-bo Bo-bobo (ボボボーボ・ボーボボ)
7. Mutekin (ムテキマン)
8. Gekisen!! Jankenjima (激戦!!ジャンケン島)
synonyms: Bobobo-Bo Bo-Bobo? - Sawai Yoshio Short Story Anthology

title.native: ボボボーボ・ボーボボ?―澤井啓夫短編集

129541.description:
Kazuki Karasawa is a college student aiming to become an art teacher. At the school where she does teaching practice, she is entangled and troubled by her student, Tsubosaki Mimi. Kazuki finds comfort in watching the streams of her favorite VTuber, Tsubomi, but then she finds out Mimi is the person behind Tsubomi...

(Source: Comic Fuz, translated)
synonyms: My Favorite Vtuber Is My Student and I'm Her Artist!?

title.native: 推しVが教え子で私がママで！？
title.romaji: Oshi V ga Oshiego de Watashi ga Mama de!?

129542.description:
The handsome prince with the dark skin and the jewel-like eyes!

"Yoko, I've come for you." When that man, handsome as a Greek statue, appeared one night and said that to me. And my world suddenly changed.

129543.description: We're not in a relationship. Only a 30-second hug every day.

129553.description:
Every time she changes her mask, she gains a new ability!

There is a girl in the hot springs deep in the forest. She easily lifts huge rocks, controls the weather, and talks to animals. The secret to her abilities is the masks she wears. The profession of this girl is a "menya," someone who creates masks with special powers.

A artisan comic about the girl who energetically goes to extremes for her work, from cutting out wood to coloring patterns and finishing the masks with varnish!

129562.description:
Tsubame was once an impoverished and abused boy living on the cold streets. However, thanks to the compassion of a girl called Konoka Shirakamizawa, the heir of a rich conglomerate, he was rescued from his destitution and brought back to her mansion, where he was healed by their revolutionary medical technology.

With the help of big-breasted maid Morisaki, Tsubame must work as Konoka's servant. He becomes responsible for her everyday needs, from washing her clothes to managing her education. Unfortunately, Konoka—being the spoiled girl she is—refuses to study until she can satisfy her immense lust. This is worsened by the fact that Konoka used the medical technology at her disposal to modify her genitalia to that of a man! Of course, it's up to Tsubame and Morisaki to satisfy her.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)

129563.description: Garaku, a city where murders occur frequently. A young man involved with the yakuza saw an old man resting with a katana on a bench.

129564.description:
A love story of an office worker and a middle-aged man!
An ordinary office worker, Mei Chigasaki (25), and the manager of a large company, Yohji Hirooka (30 years older than her), meet by chance and become addicted to fetish play. What will they find after a full course of fetish play, from drinking urine to adult toys, ass-fucking, and shameful exposure play?

129566.description: Takushi Hatsujou had played with a twin brother and sister when they were all kids, and he fell in love with the sister, culminating in his asking for her hand in marriage when they grew up, to which she agreed. However, they were torn apart for 10 years until Takushi is finally able to get his grandfather's permission to marry her. When they finally reunite, he is surprised to find they both look like girls. Although he knows one of them is cross-dressing, he can't tell which is a guy and which is a girl.

Taroubei (61) decides to retire after 41 years working as a constable in the city of Edo. These two men decided to give their lives to a loyal cause. Now free from their duty, a strange friendship begins between the two of them.

129573.description: Shizuru Nagaoka has a complex about her short height. But she has a boyfriend who's much taller!? It turns out that her boyfriend is actually a soul reaper, here to watch over her for one year before he takes her life…

Yu-Ri is the perfect college student, so no one suspects she’s living a double life at night. Until Professor Baek finds out about her secret part-time job...

129579.description:
A medical mission turns fatal as Dr. Jin’s life slips away. Miraculously, he wakes on a battlefield. Instinct takes over. He tends to patients before realizing that this is the martial arts world of The Reigning Heavenly Demon! He’s reincarnated as a child with mastery of modern medicine and soon his skills draw notice. From the renowned White-scaled Doctor to the infamous Gongson Family, everyone sees his potential. But how much is Dr. Jin willing to sacrifice before risking death again?

(Source: Tapas)

title.native: ネイリストさんとお客さん

129581.description:
The extra who sacrifices herself for the beloved female lead. Princess Shuelina who is tossed aside by her biologically related father and older brother. Now I’m the main character of this odd situation. In regards to hope, I’m still neglected at this orphanage. Just as I was going to run away before the imperial family found me–

“Did you hear? The House of Grand Duke Vailot came to sponsor an orphan.”

To find a way to live, I threw myself at the villain's family, the Grand Duke’s, and-

“You can do whatever you want. I, as the Grand Duke, will protect you.”

“You’re not an orphan. You’re my younger sister.”

Why do they love me?

Just as I made up my mind to live well since I'd already become a lady of the House of Grand Duke Vailot...

"I have searched for you for a long time, my child."

This time my biologically related father, the Emperor loves me. Why are you acting like this? I said, I don't need you guys who wouldn't have listened to what Shuelina had to say. I refuse to accept your love!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Note: Promotional prologue for the homonym web novel.
synonyms: Why Are You So Obsessed with Rejecting Love?
Why Do You Love Me When I Refuse Your Request?

129582.description:
Kirari Miyamoto is absolutely ecstatic now that she is going to be the writer Mitsuru Kajiura's new editor. But, when she finally goes to see the prince-like figure of charm and charisma she had envisioned for years, she is disillusioned by the uninspired, divorced 38-year-old in front of her. Vowing to help Mitsuru recover that gorgeous inner world she loved so much, she says she will do anything to help his words come alive again... even if that means undressing herself in front of him and allowing him to touch every corner of her body...!!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: The Starry-eyed Editor and the Apathetic Writer
title.native: 夢見る編集者と無気力小説家

129583.description:
“For me, annihilation was eternal liberation.”

Having become introverted from distrust of humanity, he stopped attending university and shut himself away in a single apartment room. He harbored a desire akin to suicidal thoughts—wishing to abandon everything and live in a closet, no, to become the closet itself. And then one day... the man's face had become like a small closet... Evicted from his apartment, reduced to homelessness, immersed in a world of degradation—where would his wandering life ultimately lead? This controversial work, hammering the story of one man's bizarre fate onto the printing block as it pushes absolute loneliness to its ultimate extreme, is finally complete!! A manga entirely from traditional woodblock prints.

(Source: Seirin Kougeisha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.romaji: Aru Oshiire Atama Otoko no Hanashi

129585.description:
A young mangaka named Yoshio Tsube was drawing rental manga to support his family of seven. When he brought his new manuscript to the publisher, he met his senior, Mr. Tayama. One day, he visited Yugawara Onsen as Mr. Tayama's assistant and took a liking to the inn's maid, Yoneko. After returning to Tokyo, Yoneko visited him in Tokyo and they became close friends, but he rejected her within two months when she asked him for money.

(Source: Wikipedia Japan, translated)

Note: Published in Weekly Manga Sunday 1974-11-09, 1974-11-16 and 1974-11-23.

129601.description:
The story centers on Hiwa Natsunagi, a novice at hula dancing who nevertheless takes a job as a hula dancer at the real life Spa Resort Hawaiians hotel. The film shows the relationships between her and her colleagues.

(Source: Anime News Network)

129603.description:
"I want to be photographer Kajitsu's muse."

In front of Moeka appears Taiyou, Kajitsu's ex-boyfriend, and ex-muse. Kajitsu still likes Taiyou, but he has Moeka by his side. Unable to choose, this love triangle begins.

title.native: 私がHな〇〇させるんですか!?
title.romaji: Watashi ga H na 〇〇-sa Serun desu ka!?

129605.description:
Every kiss is cursed!

Haekyung's got it all: looks, personality, job. But there's one thing messing up his seemingly perfect life — a jinx. Whenever he kisses someone, he gets dumped, his projects fail, and general misery ensues. Now freshly single, will Haekyung be able to overcome his jinx?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 16 extra chapters.

129606.description: Police officer Reinholt who went to a 5-star hotel for a vacation wanted a one night stand at first sight with a man who introduced himself as “Milo”. In that passing moment when Reinholt thought of how he wanted to have a special relationship with him, he saw Milo with an unusual crowd… Is that guy part of the mafia…? Even when Reinholt teld himself in his mind that he shouldn't, his heart was doing the opposite and it kept reacting to Milo. Kill or be killed… This is the dizzying romance between a police officer and a mafia!

129607.description: Yamato and his friends are having a party when suddenly they all find themselves shrunk down to three inches. Now they have to fight for survival against bugs and giant wild animals while also finding out what’s going on and how they shrank.

title.native: ハコヅメ別章 アンボックス

129615.description:
While out shopping, Mo Xiaoxia runs into her high school sweetheart, Lin Han, on the street. A series of chaotic yet heart-racing memories slowly begins to surface in Mo Xiaoxia's mind -- the story of the two girls.

(Source: Manman Manhua, translated)

129616.description:
Qin Yuefang was reborn after a car accident, but was reborn in a body named "Fang Yeyin". By chance, Yeyin met his younger self! He was tied by Qin Yuefang (his younger self) and became his possession... As Fang Yeyin attempts to discover the truth of the his reincarnation, he also has to escape the clutches of this perverted Qin Yuefang. But will things go smoothly...?

(Source: Kuaikan Manhua, translated)

129617.description:
Constantin de Arambourg, the knight of the garden, is an overly serious knight who guards the king's kitchen garden. One day, he met a beautiful woman chasing a rabbit in the garden. When she caught the rabbit with her bare hands, she said: "I'll turn you into a meat pie, rabbit!" When she said this with a smile, his heart was struck like lighting - and he fell in love!

(Source: Hobby Japan, translated)

title.native: 『王の菜園』の騎士と、『野菜』のお嬢様
title.romaji: "Ou no Saien" no Kishi to, "Yasai" no Ojou-sama

129618.description:
Whenever he steps foot outside, Do-Jun is faced with an unexpected challenge – the seemingly never-ending public displays of affection from his next-door neighbors! But the fact that they’re both men means that Do-Jun’s discomfort quickly earns him the label of homophobe. Determined to break free from stereotypes, Do-Jun attempts to bridge the gap by reaching out to his neighbor, only to find himself entangled in far more than neighborly relations.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes five side story chapters.

129619.description:
“Every day, I ravenously awaited those 30 minutes”... Hwane is studious, careful, and serious. Jinha is popular, cool, and fun. They seemed so different, and yet, throughout high school, they secretly met up for silent, passionate encounters. Hwane treasured these moments—until he is betrayed by Jinha’s denial of him to their classmates. It haunts him even into adulthood. When chance brings them back together, will it restart their hot love or will they both be burned in disaster?

(Source: Tapas)

129620.description:
After calling off his engagement, Xinglai once again meets his former lover, Xiwu.

Thinking that this is a second chance in their relationship, Xinglai gives his all to stay with him.

A heartwarming boys' love comic of two men finding each other once more to give love another shot.

(Source: INKR Comics)

129621.description: Violant Lesserhain. That’s the name of the villain who appears in the comic “Princess Dances with the Night.” After the protagonist’s accidental death, for some reason he wakes up as Vio, and decides to walk in his shoes. Then it strikes him: before the “Hero” slays him, he must not tread a villain’s path…

129622.description:
In a village that is like the “First Village”, lived the innkeeper’s son, Ruth. In his previous life he had no affinity to women because he was a burly man but since he has become a handsome youth in this life, he is going to do his best (However, he still isn’t popular at all). At that time, he discovered that his childhood best friend, Alec, was a hero. And then, for some strange reason, Alec begged Ruth “Until I come home, please wait for me”…

There is a tale in the First Village where the famous people who were involved with the hero, Alec, came along one-by-one to cause trouble and approach Ruth, who was leisurely living out his life in the countryside.

A spoiled and infatuated Hero x A dense and broad-minded Innkeeper’s son.
synonyms: The Traveling Hero Won’t Let the Innkeeper’s Son Escape

129625.description: The tavern owner’s son, Ilya, often experienced the same dream. A dream in which he played in the village orphanage with his childhood friend, a boy whose appearance resembled an angel’s. A dream where he made soap with olives and soup with leftover vegetables. But the moment Ilya laid eyes on the picture of the “Icy Hero,” he realized that those dreams weren’t dreams at all; rather those were the memories of his past life. Most importantly, that “Icy Hero,” Riley, wasn’t angelic anymore?!
synonyms: The Icy Hero is Yearning for Love

129626.description: A failed rescue mission, a man driven into desperation, a deity who lost his powers. Guarding a vow made in a past life in return for today. If we meet again, will you remember me?

129632.description:
Lee Ho-Jae had given up his life as a pro gamer, until one day he received a mysterious message:

“Congratulations! You’ve been invited to the Tutorial World.”

Intrigued, he enters the game and confidently chooses “hell” difficulty, but soon learns that he is trapped there. With a mere 0.01% survival rate, Ho-Jae must somehow overcome the game’s agonizing challenges to figure out the real reason he was invited. This tutorial may be tough, but its secrets are what’s truly hellacious.

(Source: Tapas, edited)
synonyms: チュートリアルが死ぬほど難しい

129636.description:
You, who in the manhwa that I draw, can we meet beyond this squared space that I created?

(Source: KToon, translated)

129637.description: For some reason, Mahiru is able to see people’s past life. In her own past life, she was a seal born in the Arctic, in which she ended up savagely eaten by a polar bear. The occasional nightmares about her past life still trouble her until this day. Then one day, the said polar bear from her past life suddenly appeared before her in the form of a handsome man!
synonyms: Ms. Seal: I don't wanna be killed anymore

129639.description:
It is a pure-love comedy between childhood friends!

(Source: Author's Pixiv, translated)

129640.description: The main character, Yoshizumi Yuya, was being pressured into paying off the debt left by his parents who had fled abroad. It was his classmate, Hitotsuba Kaede, chosen as the cutest schoolgirl in Japan, who saved him from this crisis of life and death. However, there was a catch. The condition required to fulfill in return for taking over his debt was — “In return for the loan, you have – to live with me.”
synonyms: I’m Gonna Live with You Not Because My Parents Left Me Their Debt But Because I Like You

Honam and Sooyeon have been together for four years. Sooyeon thought he knew everything there was to know about Honam, but Honam is actually a half-tiger, half-human just days before becoming fully human! Dajun, the owner of the place Sooyeon works, is actually a half-tiger, half-human that's given up on becoming a human...? What will become of Sooyeon suddenly stuck between these two tigers?

(Source: Copin Comics)

Instead of holding her accountable, Marie makes a strange suggestion to Seon, who is falsely being accused to have stolen the class' money. Was it a helping hand?

129644.description:
Ah Reum Park, 34 years old. 11 years as Secretary to senior director of the strategic development department of the HK company. Not sure why, but my brother trusted and relied on her. But my brother's woman isn't to my liking. Although, that isn't really important.

“I'm going to take everything that belonged to my brother. The first thing to take will be this position. And then...”

(Source: Copin Comics)

129646.description:
A collection of stories about the unexplainable pangs that prickle your heart during the beginning stages of love:

1. My First Love: Big Honey: Tatsunori goes through relationships (and break-ups) like the seasons. He can only date guys that he finds attractive, guys that look like Keito, an old, unrequited love from high school. And as luck would have it, Tatsu and Keito meet again in university, but Keito looks nothing like he used to in high school.

2. Roommates and Physical Bonding: Kensei welcomes John, a foreign exchange student from America, into his apartment as a new roommate, a decision Kensei has regretted ever since, as John is a stickler for tidiness while Kensei is... well... not. Will the two ever be able to coexist peacefully? Or maybe there is some heart behind their bickering?

3. Lovers' Stairway: Masa and Fuji know that everybody is doing it; they even witnessed it themselves in the school bathroom. But all they've ever done is a kiss. What will they do when a golden opportunity arises and they find themselves alone in a locked room?

4. If This Feeling Can Be Called Love: Misono has always been the shining star on a clear path to success. With top grades and social skills in high school, no one was surprised when he graduated from a famous university and entered a big-name trading company. But even on his elite path, there was one person Misono could never win over, much to his frustration. Sakura, the weird outcast of his class and was always unimpressed by Misono's eliteness. What was it about Sakura that made Misono tick? And why is he still frustrated even when they meet again years after high school?

(Source: Futekiya)

129647.description:
"I like you. I don't want to remain as owner and pet, but I want to be lovers."

Hae-sin Baek enters a convenience store with a friend and is abruptly kissed by part-timer Won Choi. Shocked, Haeshin avoids him, but Won is persistent and reveals his secret that Haeshin is his savior.

Will Won, a werewolf that commits their whole life to one owner, be able to make his puppy love come true?

(Source: Copin Comics)

title.native: スーパーアイドル ゴリ美

129651.description: Tsukasa Minase is an 11-year-old boy who gets asked by his next door neighbor and novelist Chifuyu Kuga to dress up as a girl to help her write her current manuscript.

title.native: 小説と、少年と、セーラー服。
title.romaji: Shousetsu to, Shounen to, Sailor Fuku.

129660.description: A city full of filth and parasites. This sewage town was built by the people living in the sewer. The upper city does not know anything about the lower city. This is a place inhabited by those who live in the drainpipes, where "normal" things have no place. A collection of early works, including the contributions and debut works of Saizou Horihone.

129662.description: The pianist she hires for her events business is very handsome. But his mysterious and flighty attitude drives her crazy — or so she thought!?

129663.description:
Cha Sunwoo, the broadcasting station’s signature announcer of TBC and the only son of “Handman”. For him, love is like Jenga. Even tho it looks perfect at first it gradually collapses…So he doesn’t believe in falling in love at first sight.

“I feel in love at first sight, I love you, Mr. Cha Sunwoo.” …Except for spending the night with Lee Gyuwon two years ago. "Why didn’t you contact me, I’ve been waiting all this time?”

Seonwoo and Gyuwon, reunite as announcers and reporters at the TBC new agency, which acts as a battlefield. Gyuwon, whether at work or at home, purses Seonwoo again and begins a breathtaking and tempting journey. Seonwoo, who tries not to fall into the fierce but tempting courtship…

“Ha, I’m going crazy because of you. What do you want to do with me?”.

129665.description:
Ye Fengwu, a capable male actor who debuted after filming in an X-rated movie, is known as the pinnacle of the age of beauty in the entertainment industry. During a vacation in Europe, he met the mysterious rich man, Augustine, and an intimate and dangerous relationship began. Emotions, gambling, wealth, dark past and a hidden truth...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

129666.description:
Huang Yue, an auspicious cloud thousand years ago, died because he wanted to be together with Xia Ying, the Yinglong Dragon and thus suffered the Thunder Trial. Xia Ying tried his best to keep Huang Yue's soul, so Huang Yue could have another life. And in this life, Huang Yue reincarnated as God of Marriage. Because of his poor performance, he was kicked to the mortal world to match the unattached and encountered Xia Ying. Fate brought them together again. They began to deal with those love affairs together and came to know the truth of their previous life.

(Source: Webnovel)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and 9 extras.
synonyms: The Moon God Doesn't Understand Love

129668.description:
A sexy new spin-off of Body Complex!! Enjoy this steamy compilation of the mature scenes from the original series, now made even more intimate. Jae-Hyun is a piano prodigy picked up by Kang Min-Woo, a world-renowned classical music professor. Outside of the classroom, they are secretly lovers, but Seo-Jin's surprise appearance soon changes everything...

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: Sex Complex - Body Complex CG Toon
title.romaji: Sex Complex: Body Complex CG Toon

129669.description:
Grown up together since childhood with Youngji, Ji-ho realizes that he has been in unrequited love for several years.

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: What Secret is There Between Us

129670.description: The monster action manga follows the members of the Metropolitan Police Department's Special Crimes Countermeasures Public Safety Division's "S Section," which investigates crimes impossible to explain with science, and with links to mysterious creatures.

129672.description:
Reki, a high school sophomore and skater, is addicted to “S,” a highly secret and dangerous downhill skateboarding race that takes place in an abandoned mine. The skaters are especially wild about the “beefs,” or heated battles that erupt in the races.

Reki takes Langa, a transfer student returning to Japan after studying abroad, to the mine where the races are held. Langa, who has no skateboarding experience, finds himself pulled into the world of “S”...

(Source: Aniplex of America)

129674.description:
In a world where demi-beasts and humans co-exist, Riku Kurobuchi, a panther demi-beast, finds himself facing a dilemma. He is sociable, good looking, talented at sports, and popular with girls, but for some reason he still hasn't experienced his "heat" like everyone else. After an unexpected transfer, he begins sharing his dorm room with the mature and handsome albino lion demi-beast, Touma Shishigaya. Riku wants to keep his secret hidden from the confrontational Touma, but it's Touma's pheromones that bring about Riku's first heat!!

This is a story of desire between a beautiful albino and an inexperienced demi-beast.

(Source: Brite Publishing)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: プレイボーイ・ビースト

129675.description: The manga is set in the year 2018, and begins with the "Helltopia Incident," the worst terrorist attack in Japanese history. The perpetrators are evil cyborgs with abilities that far surpass those of normal humans. A normal high school student named Tsunehiko Kamijō gets involved in the incident.

title.native: 姉ぶるいろねの色じかけ

129681.description:
Felicia, who suddenly gets back her memories from the previous life, is married off to a distant foreign land by her enthroned elder brother as harassmentーthis world is that of an otome game, and my marriage partner, Crown Prince William, is in love with the saintess from another world. Thus I, the hindrance, will be executed?! To avoid the destruction flag, Felicia decides to live as a commoner while making medicine.

However, William whispers breathtakingly alluring words into her ears... What kind of a trap is this?!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: Since a Saintess Is Coming From Another World, I, the Hindrance, Want to Disappear

129683.description: During middle school socially anxious Yuki experienced losing a running competition for the first time. When entering high school he met his rival again and he gets swept up by his rival in joining the running club in high school. The bubbly personality of his rival Kawai are slowly but surely also bringing changes to himself. Unsure of these changes Yuki tries to push Kawai away, but Kawai doesn't want to accept this.

title.native: 無口な想いは恋となる
title.romaji: Mukuchi na Omoi wa Koi to Naru

129685.description: This story follows the simple and domestic day-to-day lives of Rihito and Hikaru, who have recently begun their newlywed life together.

129687.description:
Cha Jae-Hyeon’s had it easy for the past few years. His job as a PE teacher is a no-brainer, plus, he’s enjoying the more illicit perks that come with the job. However, his comfy lifestyle is brought into peril with the appearance of the deceptively soft-spoken school inspector, Lee Sun-Jin. Sun-Jin catches onto Jaehyun’s secret and uses it to get what he wants, which is…to do whatever he desires to Jae-Hyeon's body. Initially, Jae-Hyeon only feels humiliation, but humiliation quickly turns into something different. It’s a physical education like no other, one where excrutiating pain turns into inexorable pleasure. A new series from the writer of “Dine With a Vampire!"

(Source: Lezhin US)

129694.description:
When Hayato's grandmother passed, he planned to sell her rundown café on the shore—not realizing that it was also home to five young women who call themselves her family?! Their desperation to keep the café open convinces Hayato to give it a shot...but even their best intentions might not be enough to make it work! And can he even work with these five unruly women? No matter what, he's got his work cut out for him! A fun new romcom by the author of Fuuka and Suzuka!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

129697.description: A high school debut with a classmate. A Kabedon from a cram school friend. A date with a hobby friend. A love confession from a childhood friend. This is a collection of four love stories between friends! Experience a dreamlike love from a male friend that will fulfill a girl's desire for a pounding heart. This is the first omnibus by an up and coming shoujo mangaka!

129699.description:
Jin-Wook is happy that his childhood friend Seung-Min returned after he moved away years ago. As the two grow closer, their friend Young-Jae grows jealous of their intimacy. A love triangle forms between three boys in the cool spring season of their senior high school life.

(Source: INKR Comics)

title.english: Spring Fallen Classroom And Two Fools

129700.description:
Real Zama's first and last love ended because a fortune teller said there was zero compatibility. A few years later, Real has become that very thing: a fortune teller. But, rather than taking advantage of poor wandering souls for their fat wallets, Real tells it like it is and has earned the reputation of being a harsh fortune teller. One day, when a sickly looking Shoujirou Futami walks in and explains how another fortune teller had told him to drink a suspicious bottled substance called "Vital Hydrogen Water,"" Real advises he go to the police and to stop drinking the mystery liquid before it's too late A month later, the transformed Shoujirou appears in front of Real to repay him for his help. Although his naivety and lack of awareness anger Real, he may be the only person to lean on when Real is in trouble!

(Source: Futekiya)

Note: Includes an extra.

129701.description:
High schooler Hana Kim channels her pain and angst by leading a secret life as Sparrow, the live streamer! In her vids, she shares her love of poetry yet never her own face, because — let’s be honest — people are the worst, especially on the internet. Her cherished anonymity is broken when her classmate Aster discovers her private life and wants to get closer to her. Will she keep her distance from him? Or will she let down the walls she built to protect her heart from life’s cruel realities?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: The Poem of Aster and Hana

129702.description:
In the far future, advanced technology made it possible to build a dome city in space. Chess arrives in this city after learning that Esther, his rich sister, has died.

(Source: INKR Comics)

129703.description: Hani, who lost her mother from illness as a child, is an orphan living alone. Following her passing, Hani's father found another woman and leaves the house filled with the memories of Hani's mother. Hani, feeling betrayed, turns to her strength, running.

129704.description:
The only way to escape a stalker... Join a temple?

(Source: Manta)

129705.description:
Age 41, Oh Jung-Seok. A man who did all kinds of misdeeds and put his life on the line for the organisation to gain the highest position. But who knew the end of his life would be so miserable… Jung-Seok’s ‘virtuous living’ project starts now, one by one.

(Source: Naver, translated)

The target is Oh Jung-Seok and all the students at Sampo High School!

The scale itself is completely different from before. Now, the Iljin Alliance, a group of all the bullies from each school, begins to grab and bully Sampo High School students at random. One day, a man came up to Jung-Seok and told him to come to visit him as much as he wanted...

Welcome to “Whale Barbershop”! Where there’s bubbling shaving foam, crisp scraping sounds from the razor, slightly pungent smell of pomade, and a man with a soft touch!

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

129713.description:
Zhou Chengyi is a bossy president. He finally falls in love with a girl when he is 27 years old. However the girl he loves is a straight man who just wears women's clothes. The man is a online celebrity model. Turning from a die-hard fan to a sasaeng fan of him, Zhou Chengyi is confused about what true love is.

(Source: WeComics)

Note: Chapter count includes 5 extras.

Zhou Cheng Yi's Bumpy First Love

129714.description:
Mu Yiran, an orphan girl, died with hatred in the post-Apocalyptic era. After getting a rebirth by chance, she goes back to three days before Doomsday. In this life, she has managed to deal with the mistress and the guy who two-timed her. She has got a space for immortality cultivation and uses it to stock as many supplies as possible, but accidentally, she offends the strongest marshal of the post-Apocalyptic era. "Girl, you have no way to run!" The romantic story between the stone-faced marshal and the girl who is an immortality cultivator therefore begins.

(Source: WeComics)

129715.description:
Kanon, a live-in servant, is asked to by his boss' son, Sumikazu, to leave the mansion with him. However, there is a big difference in the way the two see each other...

The manga of a sweet master-servant romance!

title.native: 毎日カノン、日日カノン

129716.description:
Primabelle is astonished when she wakes up to find herself in a novel of her own creation as an obscure painter who gets killed by the male protagonist, Prince Rainsis. The world she created has not been kind to Rainsis. In addition to being colorblind, he has been shunned and feared his entire life, for a prophecy had been made that “the one trapped in a black and white world shall drench the empire in blood.” Primabelle resolves to disprove the prophecy after witnessing his misery firsthand. To do so, she must track down his destined other half. The only problem? All she knows about the fair beauty is that she has black hair and crimson eyes. Will Primabelle be able to help Rainsis see the world in all its splendid colors and find true happiness?

(Source: Tappytoon)

129717.description:
Princess Mio is betrothed to Prince Chika. However, they’ve never met, and he doesn’t know her secret—she’s a mermaid! When her tutor, Yuri, takes her out of the castle to meet her subjects, Mio begins to accept her true self. But Yuri has a secret too… And when Mio tells her father, the king, she wants to live life openly as a mermaid, he punishes her. How can she stay true to herself?

(Source: VIZ Media)

Note: Chapter count includes seven additional chapters, one in each volume.

title.english: In the Name of the Mermaid Princess
title.romaji: Mio no Na no Moto ni

129718.description:
A warrior who was slaughtered at the hands of his comrades after having saved the world from monsters, wakes up in an unknown world after his death.

After attaining a second chance at life, he vows to live his life in debauchery, but the way his savior gazes at him... is somewhat strange.

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes 2 side stories.

129724.description:
Ever wondered what popular folktales would be like if more men were involved?! The answer is: perfectly queer! Classic folktales from around the world take on a whole new hunky spin when boy loves boy. From Korean fables like "The Tale of Chunhyang" to more well-known fairy tales like "Snow White," you'll never read the originals the same way again.

(Source: TappyToon)

129725.description:
"Before my generation was born... A pandemic had brought change to our world."

In the near future, hiding your mouth behind a mask became a normal part of life. Natsuki, a girl fascinated by the world before the global pandemic; and Hata, her classmate, end up sharing a small secret... The story of their new everyday life, their "new normal" begins here!

(Source: Funguild)
synonyms: โลกยุคใหม่ของฉันกับเธอ
New Normal: Sentimentos em um mundo pós-pandemia

129726.description:
A war correspondence photographer, Jo-Yoon Ha, wakes up from a five-year-long coma after being shot in a war zone while covering a story. He wakes up only to find that his boyfriend had moved on and found another partner. While Yoon Ha was able to recover from his war zone injuries, he's not sure if he can recover from the heartbreak over his lost love. He tries to get past the heartbreak by meeting other people platonically or sexually.

The story is a tale of a journey to find healing for a broken heart. Will it become reality?

(Source: Pocket Comics, edited)

title.native: フロントラインスピリッツ

129736.description:
Woo-Jung was a child star who had to give up his dreams because of some malicious rumors. Carrying that trauma with him, he’s now just a normal high school student. When some bullies confront Woo-Jung on the first day of school, a majestic figure, like a hero from a video game, magically comes to Woo-Jung’s rescue...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes an epilogue and seven side story chapters. The side stories are rated R19.

129737.description:
“I…thought you were dead…”

For ten years, Cináed has lived solely for revenge, driven by the events of a decade ago. Despite the concerns of his long-time friend Rahman, he secretly prepares for his vengeance under the alias "Chaff," alongside his loyal retainer Yexing.
During his quest, Cináed discovers Albin, whom he believed to be dead, and rescues him. As they live together under the guise of protection, Cináed is struck by how much Albin has changed from their childhood days. This new Albin stirs unfamiliar emotions within Cináed, complicating his single-minded pursuit of revenge.
As Cináed’s feelings for Albin deepen, his thirst for revenge begins to wane. Will he choose the path of vengeance, or will Albin’s presence lead him to a different destiny?

(Source: Lezhin US)

129746.description:
Yaji and Kita and their adventures parody two comedic figures from Japanese literature who wandered from town to town, encountering bad guys and generally making fools of themselves. In this iteration, they are two schoolgirls who wander from school to school, fighting the bad guys and generally saving the day. Rei Shinokita (Kita) is a butchy, serious blonde girl with a penchant for rescuing (and becoming the object of affection for) lovely young ladies, and Junko Yajima (Yaji) is a tall, lovely brunette girl with a impetuous nature and a habit of rescuing (and becoming the object of affection for) beautiful boys. In practically every arc of Yajikita, you can be sure of a few things – the yakuza will be involved, there will be much fighting, Yaji and Kita will be inutterably cool, the girl will fall in love with Kita and the boy with Yaji.

(Source: Okazu, edited)

Note: Yajikita Gakuen Douchuuki was initially serialized in Bonita from 1982 to 1991. It continued to be serialized in Mystery Bonita from December 6, 2003, to February 6, 2006. The first 22 volumes were published by Akita Shoten between 1983 and 1991; volumes 23 through 29 were published from 2004 to 2006.

As a loser protagonist, he has a shocking name of "Gao Fu Shuai(Rich, Tall and Handsome)," despite facing employment issues he also experiences a series of incredible events. As the gears of destiny quietly turns, he challenges the apex of power and continues towards the peak of life.

129810.description:
Tomomi works in a company that's supposed to provide her with board and lodging, so when she's suddenly told to temporarily leave her apartment, she's at a loss. With nowhere to go, she accepts the offer to share a room... with Ryou, a handsome but unreadable man. In exchange for a place to live, she has to take care of the housework, but no one told her she had to become a host as well! On top of that, there's another secret condition she must fulfill... and it involves getting very, very close with Ryou!

129812.description:
One strange day, Dorothy and her boyfriend, Toto, are swept away by a mysterious tornado to Munchkinland, an imaginary country filled with music-loving dwarves. Encouraged by the Good Witch of the North, Dorothy and Toto decide to start a band and embark on a journey to Oz, the famous record company. Along the way, the couple encounters a gifted scarecrow guitarist, a tin bass player, and a drumming lion. Together, they are the Dorothy Band!

(Source: Tapas)

129813.description:
The peculiar story of a writer, a boy, their pets, a hitman, and some old wizard... and just when you thought you had it figured out... Ale, a man of high reputation among those in the Dark Arts is hired by a famous horror novelist who goes by the name of Nero. Their first meeting is a bit of awkward.
Nero, finds himself in a bit of a predicament. The body that once was his (whether he liked it or not) is no longer his, but this isn't your typical transformation story.
The entire world is transforming around them. What seemed like a simple solution spirals into this tangled plot. Supernatural forces are at play. The Dark Arts, will they be friend or foe?
Well, what don't you understand?

(Source: Tapas)

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

As a male prostitute in the slums, Je-oh is at the bottom of the social hierarchy. A pawn among pawns. Sure, he's tried to break away, but each attempt has only left him with more wounds. Until one day, he gets rescued...by a serial killer who kidnaps him along with his pimp. The killer, Seong-rok, is on a mission for his lover, a former prostitute plotting to turn the tables. Why he rescued Je-oh is unclear, but a slick-talking manwhore was definitely not part of anyone's plan. Regardless, Je-oh is no ordinary pawn. In exchange for God saving her younger sister’s life, Lefina is reborn in another world as a villainess. After giving a brilliant performance as the despised duchess, and ensuring that the heroine and Crown Prince are engaged, Lefina quit being a noble. Now, she works as a castle maid! What awaits her is a carefree lifestyle where she can eat delicious Japanese commoner food! She enjoys her new life while using her special skill that allows her to master anything with just one glance. Lefina enjoys the life of a commoner, and soon her reputation among those around her begins to change......? The happy commoner life of the former villainess begins here!

(Source: Alpha Manga)

129841.description:
Chang-Ho, a man who has no luck in finding love, goes to a renowned shaman after suffering countless breakups. The shaman says that the reason for his lack of luck is his best friend, Do-Hyun. The two of them have to be connected by the string of fate for a month to restore Chang-Ho’s luck. How will they survive living together?

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and an epilogue.

129842.description:
If you take off the checkered shirt and thick rimmed glasses on his head, you get a handsome and young blond man?! The nerdy Ethan fell in love with Dwayne at their high school prom. With no progress for 4 years, Ethan reunites with Dwayne in his graduation party. Dwayne, ignoring Ethan who had mustered up his courage to go talk to him, feels something hard graze his hand as he walks past the nerdy boy. This guy has something amazing…!

"You.. Do you wanna do something fun with me?"

What will happen to the nerdy boy, Ethan?

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

129843.description:
Only after Empress Lizzie died did Emperor Leon realize his foolishness and regretted it too late, but the time had already passed.

With Leon's wishes, the Witch of the Clock Tower turned back time to the day Leon first met Empress Lizzie, and all Leon had to do, after returning to the past, was to make Lizzie happy.

But the influence of turning back time was greater than he thought. Will Leon be able to make a happy ending with Lizzie this time?

(Source: Naver, translated)

129846.description: Harumi is a clumsy new OL at a soap company. Her supervisor Yukime-senpai is beautiful and smart, always working efficiently. Harumi admires Yukime-senpai greatly and wants to get along with her, but it's difficult when Yukime seems so cold and intimidating at work. Until one day, Harumi ran into Yukime at a bath house. As they sat together in the hot-spring bath, Yukime's expression finally seemed to relax and lighten up.

I absolutely refuse to stand idly by when it comes to money and live a boring life! Then, one day, out of the blue, she won 1.8 billion yen in the lottery! Miyako, once an ordinary office worker, saw her life completely transformed. At first, she quit her job and spent all her time shopping, but after “hiring” Toru—whom she met on a trip to New York—she moved to the city. Together with her best friend Satsuki, she launched a jewelry business…

129862.description:
Will you marry me?

Alice, a poor girl who has been oppressed for years in the kingdom of Welbeza, made a once-in-a-lifetime confession.

But the one who accepts is the next duke, whom she’s never met before! Arthur Grindelwald is a man of great beauty.

The beautiful Arthur Grindelwald has a gentle smile and affirms her lack of confidence. And he swore he would do anything for her?

With such good fortune, Alice sets out to become a duchess.

The road is hard, and there is no shortage of people who take advantage of her weakness.

But no matter what happens, Arthur’s love for her burns brighter and brighter. ……

She’s not the only one to fall in love with him.

No one will ever touch you again.

(……Why do you love me so much?)

A sweet and heavy story about two people with a secret past. It’s a miracle, a royal Cinderella story!

129863.description:
Deirdre Abel von Belisario just wants to find love! After dying young in her first life—and worse, dying without a single hint of romance—this former office worker and self-proclaimed otaku has found herself reincarnated as the daughter of a margrave in another world. Determined to make the most of her second chance, she's set on finding love and giving her parents the grandchildren they deserve.

Unfortunately for Deirdre, fate has other plans in store. She never meant to catch the eye of her land's Royal Spirits, let alone gain their blessing. And she definitely didn't mean to get pulled into the conflict between spirits and humans. She was just bored!

Left with no choice but restore harmony to the empire, her dreams of a peaceful married life seem farther out of reach than ever.

This is the story of a “graceful” young lady reluctantly revolutionizing an empire along the rocky road to love!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

An Juan, 20 years old, dreams of being a cartoonist. This year she finally achieved her dream of being accepted to the studio of the cartoonist she admired the most. Bai Zhan, the leader of the idol group TREE, finds himself switching body with an unknown girl overnight! What's worse, he finds that girl is his hater as well as the most devoted fan of his group member, Ji Shan. She takes possession of Bai Zhan's body and even moves into the group's apartment! It seems that this stupid and stubborn girl really appreciates this destined chance to stay with her idol and she refuses to cooperate to find the way to switch their bodies back!!! GEE!!! Now, Bai Zhan comes up with a wonderful idea... If I make her my devoted fan, then everything will go as I want!

However, this secret is discovered by the notorious pervert Duke Hetzel… A bitter-sweet love story thus begins to unfold.

(Source: Webnovel)

129881.description:
A girl from the modern world slips into the body of Niveia Aerber, the main character of the fantasy novel she was reading. To survive in Erathil, a world full of betrayal and monsters where she was destined to meet an early death, the new Niveia embarks on an adventure to escape from her fate.

The old Niveia was set to become the next Priestess to serve the Grand Temple, but not the new Niveia. Instead, she runs away from the temple, from her archrival, Rosanna, and her fiancé, Duke Aetius Timothero. Along the way she enlists the help of Prince Caeles, who is also on a mission of his own: to find out which noble families are planning an uprising against his kingdom, including Niveia's family.

In this Chaotic turmoil of love, loyalty, and treason, can Niveia create a better future for herself, and more importantly, can she ever return to the real world?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Note: Includes seven side story chapters.

129882.description:
Kenichi Yamada, a single, 35-year-old businessman, has spent the majority of his adult life playing every MMORPG to hit the market. Tired of the constant cycle of repetitive, newbie-centric gameplay, he is immediately drawn in by the promise of a new game that, on top of being never-ending, offers up a “Hell Mode”—a difficulty level that makes it nigh impossible to level up but also promises uncapped growth potential.
Upon selecting the newly released Summoner class, Kenichi finds himself reborn as Allen, an infant in a serf family, with nothing but his wits and old memories to guide him.
Allen works diligently to level himself up despite Hell Mode requiring vast amounts of experience between levels. In doing so, he hopes to uncover the secrets the Summoner class holds. All the while, he dedicates himself to freeing his new family from serfdom.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

129883.description:
“‘Level up even while offline’?! That’s not a game on ‘easy mode’—that’s just an AFK game!”

The online game Yamada Kenichi had been playing religiously is shutting down its servers, leaving him with a void in his heart. He looks for a new game to fill it, but everything he finds is way too easy. The kind of game he likes—the kind punishing enough to make players want to spend thousands of hours on it—just isn’t around anymore. “What’s this? ‘You are invited to a game that will never end.’” Kenichi stumbles upon an untitled game, one promising incomparable challenge with unprecedented potential. Without hesitation, he selects the “Hell Mode” difficulty. Lo and behold, he finds himself reincarnated in another world as a serf! Now called Allen, he sets out to unlock the secrets of his mystery-laden Summoner class; without the convenience of walkthroughs, game guides, or online forums, he must grope his way to the top of his new world!

(Source: J-Novel Club)
